lip-blushing-behandeling-nederland.title: Lip blushing treatment Netherlands
lip-blushing-behandeling-nederland.excerpt: Lip Blush is a pigmentation technique for the lips, comparable to tattooing but less deep. The treatment can create symmetry, conceal scars and make the lips appear optically fuller.
lip-blushing-behandeling-nederland.author: IZZI Beauty
lip-blushing-behandeling-nederland.seoTitle: Lip Blushing Treatment Netherlands - IZZI Beauty
lip-blushing-behandeling-nederland.seoDescription: Lip Blush is a name for pigmenting your lips. Pigmentation is comparable to tattooing. The result is often very natural.

body.heading: What Lip Blushing Tattoo is
paragraphs: Lip Blush is pigmentation of your lips, in which ink is applied with a needle into the upper layer of skin — deeper than regular makeup but shallower than traditional tattoos. Lips are naturally transparent; the circulation determines their colour. Through pigmentation, irregularities in colour and symmetry can be corrected.

body.heading: When do you choose Lip Blushing?
paragraphs: Correcting asymmetrical lips — a stylist can subtly fill in irregularities for better symmetry.
Distributing pigmentation more evenly — on darker skin types, pigmentation differences can easily be harmonised. Expect the colour to fade 40-60%; a touch-up after 6-8 weeks is recommended.
Improving poor circulation — grey or blue lips can be made warmer by pigmenting with warmer tones.
Optical volume enhancement — by distributing colour evenly, lips appear fuller without fillers.
Permanent lipstick replacement — enjoy your favourite colour for 2-3 years without applying makeup daily.
Concealing scars — small scars can be discreetly masked with neutral, soft colours.

body.heading: Does the Lip Blushing treatment hurt?
paragraphs: The treatment is generally experienced as more painful than Powder Brows, because the lip skin (the vermilion) is thinner. IZZI Beauty uses anaesthetic beforehand and during the treatment. Although it is a more sensitive area, the treatment is shorter because of the smaller surface.

body.heading: Benefits of Lip Blushing
paragraphs: Create more symmetry, applicable to lip fillers (minimum 4 weeks in between), conceal scars, optically fuller lips, camouflage pigmentation differences, no daily lipstick needed, soft natural contour lines, wake up with beautiful lips and a very natural result.

body.heading: Disadvantages of Lip Blushing or Lip Pigmentation
paragraphs: After the treatment, swelling, redness, itching, scabs, dryness and a pulling sensation may occur.

This is normal: the body tries to expel the ink, which causes scabs. This process starts after 3-4 days. Make sure you do not remove the scabs yourself. Apply Bepanthen ointment 3 times a day and cleanse twice a day with fragrance-free soap. After 5-6 days the scabs fall off and you see the final result. All side effects disappear within 6-7 days; after that you enjoy the result for 2-3 years.

body.heading: Where can you best have Lip Blushing done in the Netherlands?
paragraphs: When choosing a salon for pigmentation, trust is essential. IZZI Beauty advises: read Google reviews and website testimonials, research the treatment thoroughly, look at social media portfolios, check GGD certification and ask what happens in the event of complications.
A salon must have a GGD inspection (renewed every 3 years). This certifies hygienic, safe practices and correct pigmentation techniques. You are better off avoiding salons without an inspection.
Check social media for honest client reactions and work that matches your wishes. Websites should radiate trust with extensive, accurate information. Videos of treatments help as well.

body.heading: Look at the prices of Lip Pigmentation
paragraphs: Few salons offer Lip Pigmentation under €300-€350. Lower prices can indicate inexperienced practitioners. This does not automatically mean poor quality, but ask about experience and portfolio. The average in the Netherlands is €350-€600 per treatment, based on a comparison of seven salons.

faux-freckles-permanente-make-up.excerpt: Freckles that are tattooed are called Faux Freckles. Using semi-permanent makeup, freckles are placed where you would like to have them.

faux-freckles-permanente-make-up.seoDescription: What are Faux Freckles permanent makeup? It is new but is already becoming a real trend! Read everything about Freckles PMU here!

body.heading: What are Faux Freckles permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Freckles that are tattooed are called Faux Freckles. Using semi-permanent makeup, freckles are placed where you would like to have them!

The permanent makeup on the face lasts 4 to 5 years. It does depend on how you treat the PMU during the healing process or in the years after you have undergone the treatment. The three biggest culprits for permanent makeup are UV radiation, salt and peels.

body.heading: How are Faux Freckles PMU placed?
paragraphs: Faux Freckles are placed using a needle that can also be used for regular permanent makeup; think of eyeliner, powder brows and lip blushing. By dabbing the skin with the needle and letting it vibrate in the skin for about 1 second, small freckles are created. When the needle touches the skin, it leaves pigment behind. Dabbing once is not enough to create beautiful freckles. The specialist will numb the skin and go over the created freckles with the needle another 1 to 2 times.
The treatment is very mild in terms of pain; virtually little to nothing is felt during the treatment. It is also over in no time, since it is only a matter of dabbing in the right place.
Before the treatment, it is determined which pigment colour and where on the face the freckles will go. Once the client gives approval, the treatment can be started.

body.heading: Faux Freckles treatment
paragraphs: The step-by-step plan of the treatment for Faux Freckles explained:

1. The wishes are discussed. 2. Looking at photos together and advice. 3. Going through the intake form. 4. Applying anaesthetic (gel). 5. Testing pigments (colour). 6. Placing freckles with a pencil. 7. After approval the treatment starts.

8. Each freckle is worked over several times with a needle. 9. Anaesthetic in between for open skin. 10. Cleansing the skin. 11. Reviewing the result and adjusting if needed. 12. After 6-8 weeks repeat the treatment to build up pigment in layers on top of each other.

body.heading: Faux Freckles healed result
paragraphs: Want to know more about Faux Freckles, the treatment and everything that comes with it? We at IZZI Beauty explain it on our treatment page. If you still have questions you can always reach us by email, WhatsApp or via social media.

hoe-herken-je-een-goede-permanente-make-.excerpt: Permanent makeup is being offered more and more often. But how can you recognise a good salon? This article gives you nine tips to get you started.

hoe-herken-je-een-goede-permanente-make-.seoDescription: Permanent makeup is being offered more and more often. But how can you recognise a good salon? Read a number of tips to get you started!

paragraphs: Permanent makeup is being offered more and more often. But how can you recognise a good salon? We give you a number of tips to get you started.

body.heading: 1. Check whether the salon is GGD approved
paragraphs: It is extremely important to see whether a salon has undergone an inspection. After all, it is increasingly in the news that some "companies" offer PMU, fillers and Botox without having passed a proper inspection. To check a salon for permanent makeup you go to the GGD.
You can enter the name of the salon there. You will then see at which location the GGD has given approval, and until when this approval is valid.

body.heading: 2. Check the salon's social media
paragraphs: Nowadays you can find all sorts of things on social media. You can see how often a salon posts, what you think of the work and how much information a salon gives you on this platform. If a platform looks vague, has few followers, barely any information and has posted few photos of work, it quickly comes across the wrong way.
You also often see reactions from clients and the salon itself. Look at these as well, so you can see what kind of interaction a salon has with the client.

body.heading: 3. Check the reviews
paragraphs: Reviews are extremely important. Especially for businesses that really want to grow. You can read all sorts of things from reviews. There are always some bad reviews from clients who are dissatisfied but do not come from a reasonable place, and sometimes even from competitors. So filter the reviews of a business for yourself. You can, for example, read Google reviews, website reviews, Facebook reviews and Trustpilot reviews. Across all the reviews you can form a picture of the business in question.
Did you know that IZZI Beauty has more than 350 5-star reviews in total on Google Reviews and Trustpilot?

body.heading: 4. Go to the website
paragraphs: A good business will always have a supporting website. On this platform the salon can inform the client who is still in doubt. If there is no website, or a website looks very shady, ask yourself whether you want to go to the right salon.

body.heading: 5. Ask a number of questions
paragraphs: We have already heard it so often: they had no interest in me. A number of our clients told us how they ended up with us. They first approached a number of businesses, and found that they got the most information and answers to their questions from us. That is because we are genuinely interested in our client and in what our clients want to know.

Our clients often heard that they just had to book an intake appointment to get all the information. We do not think this is right. During an intake you go into the personal wishes of the client and what is possible for that particular client. If someone has questions or simply wants a bit more information, then we believe that as a salon you should be able to give this information. So if a salon does not do this, and this gives you a vague feeling, then simply do not go. First look a bit further for a salon that does show genuine interest in you as a client.

body.heading: 6. Look at healed work from the salon
paragraphs: On social media and websites there are often only photos of work that has just been placed. This is therefore immediately after the treatment. And with permanent makeup you do have to understand that after the first treatment around 40-60% disappears. The result you have just after it has been placed, and a week later, is therefore completely different. So also look at photos where clients have healed work. And whether the salon posts this at all.

body.heading: 7. Compare prices
paragraphs: Permanent makeup prices really vary widely. You can go for powder brows for around €200 up to as much as €750. This is purely in the Netherlands, because the best professionals in America easily charge around $1,500. And yes, you normally get a huge amount of enjoyment from it, because of course it lasts so long. But as you may have heard: cheap can be expensive. So do not assume that with too low a price such as €200 you will get the perfect eyebrows. But that certainly also does not mean you have to pay the full amount of €750. Sit somewhere in the middle and do what you want.

body.heading: 8. Hear-say
paragraphs: Do you have friends who have already undergone a treatment at a salon? And do they have the perfect PMU? Then think about whether you also find this true perfection and would also like to visit this salon for more information. Word of mouth has to date been the best advertising there is for all salons. A friend can tell you what her feeling was during the treatment and how she was treated. Perhaps this can also help you make a choice.

body.heading: 9. Go with your feeling
paragraphs: If you look at all the points and weigh them against each other, then the only thing left is: your feeling. If your feeling is not right, then do not go! If you doubt too much, then do not go! And if you have a good feeling about a salon, then take your time. Perhaps first just have an intake consultation so you can also make a connection with the person who will ultimately place your permanent makeup. Sleep on it.
Want to book a treatment at IZZI Beauty? Then view our treatments. Still have questions? Feel free to contact us. We are happy to help you further!

5-redenen-om-te-kiezen-voor-permanente-m.title: 5 reasons to choose permanent makeup
5-redenen-om-te-kiezen-voor-permanente-m.excerpt: Permanent makeup offers significant benefits such as time-saving and a natural appearance. Discover five compelling reasons why this treatment is ideal for different lifestyles.
5-redenen-om-te-kiezen-voor-permanente-m.author: IZZI Beauty
5-redenen-om-te-kiezen-voor-permanente-m.seoTitle: 5 Reasons to choose Permanent Makeup -IZZI PMU
5-redenen-om-te-kiezen-voor-permanente-m.seoDescription: Read the five reasons why you should choose permanent makeup! Many people know traditional makeup, but not PMU yet.

paragraphs: Many people are familiar with traditional makeup, but may not yet be aware of the benefits of permanent makeup. In this blog we tell you about five reasons why you should choose permanent makeup.

body.heading: 1. Time-saving
paragraphs: One of the biggest benefits of permanent makeup is the time it saves. Applying traditional makeup can take a lot of time every morning, especially if you are trying to create a perfect look.

Permanent makeup, however, can drastically reduce the time you spend on your makeup routine. After applying permanent makeup you have more time every morning to get ready and you can walk out the door without worries.

body.heading: 2. Natural appearance
paragraphs: Another reason to choose permanent makeup is that it gives a natural appearance. When permanent makeup is applied in the right way, it looks as if you are not wearing makeup.
This is especially useful if you do not have time to apply makeup before you leave the house, but still want to look well-groomed.

body.heading: 3. Concealing scars and imperfections
paragraphs: Permanent makeup can also be used to conceal scars and imperfections on the face. It can be difficult to use traditional makeup to hide these problems, especially if the skin is sensitive or if the scars are deep.
Permanent makeup offers a solution to these problems and can help you feel more confident.

body.heading: 4. Suitable for people with an active lifestyle
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is perfect for people with an active lifestyle. If you enjoy sports, swimming or doing a lot of outdoor activities, permanent makeup can help you always look well-groomed. It stays in place during swimming, sweating and other physical activities.

body.heading: 5. Durability
paragraphs: Finally, permanent makeup is durable. Traditional makeup can easily smudge or fade throughout the day, especially if it is warm or if your skin is sensitive.
Permanent makeup, however, stays put, even after swimming or sweating. This means you can enjoy a perfect look all day long without having to worry about touching up your makeup.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: As you can see, there are many reasons to choose permanent makeup. It saves time, gives a natural appearance, can conceal scars and imperfections, is suitable for people with an active lifestyle and is durable.
So do consider permanent makeup if you are looking for a way to simplify your makeup routine and always look well-groomed.

hoe-word-je-ggd-erkent-voor-permanente-m.title: How do you become GGD recognised for permanent makeup
hoe-word-je-ggd-erkent-voor-permanente-m.excerpt: To place permanent makeup legally in the Netherlands you must undergo a GGD inspection. This inspection checks hygiene and safety measures for you and your workspace.
hoe-word-je-ggd-erkent-voor-permanente-m.author: IZZI Beauty
hoe-word-je-ggd-erkent-voor-permanente-m.seoTitle: GGD Recognition For Permanent Makeup - IZZI Beauty PMU
hoe-word-je-ggd-erkent-voor-permanente-m.seoDescription: A GGD inspection is sometimes very complicated and you need to be well informed. We offer an online training course to get you started!

body.heading: Why do you have to be GGD approved if you want to place permanent makeup?
paragraphs: The GGD is there in the Netherlands for all hygiene and safety measures. They have determined for the whole of the Netherlands what is and is not allowed during and before placing permanent makeup. That is why you personally, and with your space, have to go through an inspection before you may officially place permanent makeup. Without a permit you absolutely may not tattoo someone's face. You can expect an inspection from the GGD every so often. You then have to meet all the requirements.

If you do not have a GGD inspection carried out and you do place permanent makeup? Then you have the chance that you create an enormous problem for yourself. Should you ever disfigure someone, or should something ever go wrong during a treatment, then you are personally liable. This can run into thousands of euros and perhaps you did not know this yet, but you can be prosecuted under criminal law for injury to a client without having undergone a GGD inspection.

body.heading: Which products do you need for a GGD recognition for permanent makeup?
paragraphs: It is important to use exactly the right products during your GGD inspection. If you use the wrong products, you have the chance that the GGD leaves and makes a new appointment with you. This ultimately costs you, in addition to the €324.67, another €108.22 per hour extra during the next appointment. And you can count on the GGD gladly spending some 60 to 120 minutes in your salon.

To make everything simpler for you we have created an online training course. Here you get to see exactly which products you need and why. We also explain to you in great detail why the GGD is not a fan of certain products, and what you can change about it so you can be sure you pass the inspection.

After you have fully completed our training course, you receive a PDF with a product list, information about where you can easily purchase all the products, extra tips & tricks and an official certificate from IZZI Brows.

body.heading: What does a GGD inspection cost for placing permanent makeup?
paragraphs: The GGD has placed a standard form on their website with the rates for being inspected. Here you can therefore look through what applies to you.

Piercing holes in ears and nostrils with a piercing instrument: €270.56. Cosmetic tattoo, permanent makeup, tattooing or piercing with disposable materials: €432.89. Follow-up cosmetic tattoo or permanent makeup: €324.67. Tattooing including autoclaving: €487. Piercing where materials are sterilised: €487. Combination of the above activities: €595.22. Re-inspection based on the hourly rate: €108.22 per hour. Exemption from permit requirement based on reduced rate: €162.34.

These are only the prices to have the space and you personally inspected; how you therefore work on a client. This inspection must be renewed every 3 years, or every time you change location. So should you move in the meantime, you are obliged to undergo a new inspection. The products and items you need are therefore not yet included.

body.heading: Step-by-step plan GGD recognition permanent makeup
paragraphs: Getting GGD approval is not that simple. And many training courses give too little information about this. They think that it is a number of simple steps and that reading the GGD guidelines should be enough, however that is not how it works. Are you curious what the exact step-by-step plan is for obtaining a GGD recognition? And which products you exactly need? Then contact us or view our online training course.

10-tips-om-de-perfecte-ombre-powder-brow.title: 10 tips to place the perfect Ombré Powder Brows
10-tips-om-de-perfecte-ombre-powder-brow.excerpt: Make time to brow map on your client. If your drawing is not good, or is not correct, then you will also follow the wrong lines. These are our ten most important tips for PMU stylists.
10-tips-om-de-perfecte-ombre-powder-brow.author: IZZI Beauty
10-tips-om-de-perfecte-ombre-powder-brow.seoTitle: 10 tips to place perfect Ombré Powder Brows - IZZI
10-tips-om-de-perfecte-ombre-powder-brow.seoDescription: 10 tips to be able to place the best ombre powder brows! How do you create a fade? Learn via text & videos.

body.heading: 1. Take the time to brow map
paragraphs: Make time to brow map on your client. If your drawing is not good, or is not correct, then you will also follow the wrong lines. Want to find out how you can draw well and tightly in 3 different ways? View the IZZI Beauty online training courses.

body.heading: 2. Place the right pigment colour
paragraphs: A lot goes into pigmenting. Especially also what kind of skin type someone has, and what will suit the client. Want to learn more about pigments? Check our online training courses.

body.heading: 3. Outline the lower line of the eyebrow tightly and further towards the nose
paragraphs: If you pull the lower line of the eyebrow tightly forwards (towards the nose) you can create a beautiful fading by only colouring in the front.

body.heading: 4. Outline the eyebrow with a white base before you start
paragraphs: Once you have drawn the eyebrow it is always wise to use a white base to outline the outline further. This sounds odd, but works very well. You create a boundary of where the lines stop. This way you can never start pigmenting a crooked shape.

body.heading: 5. With your machine, make the fading longer than where your stop line is
paragraphs: You always draw a stop line at the front of the eyebrows. That way you know where your fading should end. But if you pull the fading forwards extremely lightly and without pressure you will see that your fading becomes even more beautiful.

body.heading: 6. Take your time to pigment
paragraphs: Working in a rush is never good, but in the pigmentation profession even less so. Every eyebrow deserves the same kind of attention. The more rushed you work, the less attractive the result becomes. There are well-known brow artists from America who take as much as 4 hours to create those beautiful powder brow results.

body.heading: 7. Try different brands of pigment
paragraphs: The one pigment you are recommended from your course may work nicely, but perhaps there are countless other brands that work even better for you. So try them out!

body.heading: 8. Try to choose a deep but warm colour for your client
paragraphs: We still find it most beautiful when powder brows are truly powdery. And yet this can be seen most clearly when someone has a dark brown eyebrow colour. Pixels are then clearly visible! Especially on a light or cool skin.

body.heading: 9. Do not place permanent makeup over old PMU
paragraphs: It can happen that someone wants powder brows so badly, but still has old permanent makeup on. The result you have to place over old (incorrect shape + often a grey or red undertone) is not comparable to when you place powder brows on clean skin.

body.heading: 10. Make the ombre tail darker than the front
paragraphs: The best ombre brows have a darker tail that flows into lighter. At the fading side you also see more and more pixels, and the tail is more filled in with pixels. This gives an even more beautiful effect with fading.
Want to learn more about Ombré Powder Brows? Check our online training courses. After following a workshop you have standard guidance for up to 1 year after following the course.

hoe-worden-powder-brows-geplaatst-stap-v.title: How are Powder Brows placed? Step-by-step explanation
hoe-worden-powder-brows-geplaatst-stap-v.excerpt: Quite a lot goes into Ombré Powder Brows. You cannot just book an appointment and get started. Powder Brows last about 4 years, and sometimes even longer.
hoe-worden-powder-brows-geplaatst-stap-v.author: IZZI Beauty
hoe-worden-powder-brows-geplaatst-stap-v.seoTitle: How are Powder Brows Placed? - IZZI Beauty
hoe-worden-powder-brows-geplaatst-stap-v.seoDescription: Ombré Powder Brows last +- 4 years. So you want to make a good choice regarding the shape and pigment choice. How is this done?

paragraphs: Quite a lot goes into Ombré Powder Brows. You cannot just book an appointment and get started. Powder Brows last about 4 years, and sometimes even longer.
The steps in a row: 1. Think and look for examples of what you find beautiful. 2. Schedule an intake consultation. 3. Draw the shape. 4. Pigment choice. 5. The treatment. 6. Aftercare.

body.heading: 1. Think and look for examples of what you find beautiful
paragraphs: You can find examples of eyebrows everywhere. On Pinterest, Instagram, Facebook and online on Google Images. Look at what you would find beautiful on yourself. This is a big difference from something you find beautiful on another person. If you know that you do not like sharp and tight shapes, but you do find this beautiful in a photo on someone else, then do not bring this with you. It is not something that suits you and that you ultimately want to achieve. Look at several options and discuss these during the intake consultation.

body.heading: 2. Schedule an intake consultation
paragraphs: You can usually schedule an intake consultation online at the salon. Often a fee of €50 is charged for this. If you and the salon decide to treat the eyebrows, this 50 euros will be deducted from the treatment price.

Sometimes a salon decides not to treat. Why? You have old permanent makeup that is too visible; the shape of the old PMU is too visible; a client doubts too much; or there is a contraindication. Contraindications are always gone through with you when you have an intake consultation — think of being pregnant, breastfeeding, a blood-clotting disease or chemo.

During an intake consultation we listen to your wishes and look at your examples together. We discuss what you exactly want to achieve and why you would like to choose the powder brows. We also explain to you what we can offer and how the process works. We can also schedule a touch-up appointment that day; this second treatment is included in the price.

body.heading: 3. Draw the shape
paragraphs: In addition to listening to what your wishes are, and what we think suits your face, we measure the eyebrows according to the standards. We have 3 different methods for this. Which technique we choose depends entirely on how your eyebrows already look themselves, what your face shape is and which shape you would like to achieve.

After we have drawn the shape we can still adjust everything. We look with you when you sit upright, lie down and which side is your dominant side of your face. We do not start treating until you are satisfied and agree with the chosen shape.

body.heading: 4. Pigment choice
paragraphs: Choosing pigment is very difficult if you do not know anything about it yourself. You do not know how the pigments will turn out, whether the pigments are cool or warm, and what that actually means. Fortunately we specialise in this. Besides knowing of every colour whether it has a cool or warm undertone, we also know very well how a colour turns out on a certain skin colour. In addition we also look at your natural hair colour, your dyed hair colour, your eyes, your skin colour and even your pores.

In fact we mix pigments 95% of the time. This is how we achieve the result we are looking for. A follow-up treatment is then there to make a colour a little deeper or darker, should it heal too bright and light.

We do prefer to work too light rather than too dark. If we work too dark the result can become very dull. In addition dark pigment is harder to correct than light pigment. Also keep in mind that warmth disappears completely within a week.

body.heading: 5. The treatment
paragraphs: The treatment is only carried out when approval has been given on the drawn shape and the chosen pigment. When we start a treatment it is explained as standard how we work. We also explain to you what an anaesthetic does and when we use it. The treatment is often experienced as very mild. The anaesthetic is simply a gel that is applied when the skin is open. This absorbs within 2-3 minutes, and after that you feel nothing at all anymore.

Step-by-step plan powder brows treatment: 1. We make an outline with our PMU machine (these are only the lines of the shape). 2. The eyebrow is coloured in once with pixels. 3. After that anaesthetic is applied. 4. One eyebrow absorbs the anaesthetic, then we place the outline and colour in the other eyebrow. 5. After that it is a matter of colouring in the eyebrows with pixels. 6. After the eyebrows are finished the skin is cleaned and we let the eyebrows dry.
When the eyebrows are ready you can look in the mirror and still pass on adjustments should this be needed. After that you receive an aftercare form.

body.heading: 6. Aftercare
paragraphs: The aftercare of powder brows is extremely important. If you do not follow the aftercare rules the pigment can largely dissolve. For example, it is advised not to sunbathe, swim in salt water or undergo peels within 7-14 days. All these factors cause the pigment to dissolve more quickly.

On the GGD website you can find what proper aftercare is. In addition a salon should give you this as standard after a treatment so you can go through it again at home. The better your aftercare, the longer you enjoy the treatment.

alles-over-ombre-powder-brows.title: Everything about Ombré Powder Brows
alles-over-ombre-powder-brows.excerpt: Ombré Powder Brows is a semi-permanent eyebrow treatment in which pixels are placed for a natural powder effect. The treatment lasts about 2-3 years and requires a follow-up appointment after 6-8 weeks.
alles-over-ombre-powder-brows.author: IZZI Beauty
alles-over-ombre-powder-brows.seoTitle: Everything about Ombré Powder Brows - IZZI Permanent Makeup
alles-over-ombre-powder-brows.seoDescription: An Ombré Powder Brows is virtually painless and it is the technique to transform your eyebrows into tight & natural brows!

body.heading: What are Ombré Powder Brows?
paragraphs: The technique for creating ombre powder brows simply consists of placing the so-called 'dots' in the desired eyebrow shape. By placing these dots — also called pixels — you create a natural shading in a certain pigment colour. This natural shading is also called a powder effect. By means of large or small pixels you make the eyebrow more or less powdery. Every stylist works differently in this.

Ombre powder brows are eyebrows that last about 2 to 3 years. So you wake up in the morning with the perfect eyebrow. Also very nice on holiday, in the sauna or the swimming pool and when playing sports.

To make it a true ombre powder brow the starting pieces are very vague. This is to create the ombre effect. What is actually done is, with light pressure and long strokes of the device, to spread the pixels further apart so that the pixels do not end up close together, and therefore look less thick or defined.

body.heading: What is the difference between microblading and Ombré Powder Brows?
paragraphs: Let us first establish that the Powder Brow technique and the device are completely different from when we speak about microblading. The name says it all: micro blading = micro blade / knife cuts. With microblading you make small cuts in the skin after which the pigment soaks into the cut. This treatment is often experienced as very painful, and microblading often remains visible for only up to 6 months. A lot of pain and effort therefore for a short-term solution.

Ombré Powder Brows are applied by means of pigmentation with a microneedle; it resembles a tattoo device. However a tattoo is applied in the 3rd layer of skin, and pigmentation in the 1st layer of skin. This means that placing Ombré Powder Brows is extremely superficial. As a result this treatment is experienced as virtually painless and some clients even fall asleep with us.

The result of Ombré Powder Brows is more natural, softer, more powdery and ultimately also more fitting to the face. Of course everyone has an opinion and perhaps you find the microblading much more beautiful.

body.heading: Semi-permanent Ombré Powder Brows
paragraphs: Not only is the final result beautiful, but it is also nice that it is semi-permanent. Why? Because trends constantly change as the years go by. And what you perhaps find beautiful now can be hilarious to look back on in a few years.

Ombré Brows are semi-permanent because the pigmentation technique is used. With pigmentation the pigment is not applied deep in the skin, but in the first layer of skin. When pigmentation is done the skin tries by itself to make the pigment disappear. Around 50-60% of the pigment is rejected and disappears after the treatment. The final result of the Powder Brows is therefore much more natural than the first few days after the treatment.

body.heading: Follow-up treatment of Ombré Powder Brows
paragraphs: After the first treatment is finished many people get a shock. We of course tell you in advance that the colour will look many times darker when we are finished treating, than the final result will be.

The healing process starts almost immediately. Just as with a tattoo you will get scabs. You absolutely must not pick or pull these scabs off. When you do that you can pull a portion of pigment with them or get in the way of the healing process. This is how you create the zebra effect: the difference in pigment on the eyebrows.

You need a follow-up treatment to be able to see after the healing process whether the pigment has taken everywhere, whether the shape is lasting and whether the colour of the pigment is enough for the client's wishes. Everyone experiences it differently after 6-8 weeks. Sometimes there are clients who have nothing left from their first treatment, sometimes there are clients who barely need a touch-up.

body.heading: How long does it take before Ombré Powder Brows are fully healed?
paragraphs: The healing of the pigmented eyebrows depends on many things. Applicable to the healing are: the pH value of the skin, skin characteristic (oil-rich, greasy, dry), alcohol use or smoking, protection in the sun and the aftercare procedure.

Almost everyone experiences slight swelling, redness around the eyebrows and a tight feeling of the skin, immediately after the treatment. This already subsides within 24-48 hours. The full healing process is on average between 4-10 days. But the true colour of the pigment is only visible after 1 full month.

It is a natural reaction that the pigment that has been placed first becomes darker (scabs), then appears lighter (scabs fall off), and then becomes lighter in the skin. After this process is finished, the true colour only then comes up in the skin. This process takes a month and that is why a follow-up treatment may only be carried out after an average of 6 to 8 weeks.

body.heading: How can the Ombré Powder Brows become lighter in colour more quickly?
paragraphs: There are a number of reasons why a pigment becomes lighter more quickly over time: too much sun, too much scrubbing on the skin, using serums that cause hyperpigmentation to disappear, and not caring for and hydrating the skin properly.

Spending time on a tanning bed or fully in the sun while sunbathing, sometimes also with oil on the skin, can cause the eyebrows to diminish enormously in colour. The only thing you need to do for optimal retention of the eyebrows is to protect them with a factor (preferably factor 50) in full sun, and make sure you hydrate the skin well.

body.heading: Who are Ombré Powder Brows intended for?
paragraphs: Ombré Powder Brows can be applied to every type of skin: greasy, oil-rich, dry, average. Powder Brows are also intended for people who find they have no shape in their own eyebrow. By means of the Powder Brows you get a defined shape and you no longer have to do anything to the shape except occasionally epilate the hairs outside the shape.

Can men also have Ombré Powder Brows placed? Yes! Some men (or women) have spots in the eyebrow where there is less or no hair. By means of the Powder Brow you therefore create small pixels to fill in these spots. The final result is very natural.

body.heading: Side effects of Ombré Powder Brows
paragraphs: Powder Brows have side effects that are immediately visible or noticeable. That is because the skin is put to work to remove the applied pigment from the skin. This is an entirely natural reaction.

You mainly experience: redness, slight swelling, tickling (scabs), scabs, dryness, a darker colour, irritation and rapid pigment fading. All the mentioned side effects can be present in a mild form. There are barely any clients who experience the side effects as unpleasant.

hoe-kun-je-het-best-wenkbrauwen-epileren.title: How can you best tweeze your eyebrows?
hoe-kun-je-het-best-wenkbrauwen-epileren.excerpt: There are countless ways to epilate your eyebrows nowadays. This article explains the safest and most effective methods.
hoe-kun-je-het-best-wenkbrauwen-epileren.author: IZZI Beauty

hoe-kun-je-het-best-wenkbrauwen-epileren.seoDescription: Easy way to epilate eyebrows without pain and effort. How do you do this? You can read it in this IZZI Beauty blog!

paragraphs: There are countless ways to epilate your eyebrows nowadays. Which way is the easiest, or works best for you? And what is the safest way to epilate? We explain it to you.

body.heading: Epilating eyebrows with tweezers
paragraphs: Of course the best-known form of epilating is epilating with tweezers. You can easily epilate your eyebrows like a pro by using tweezers. Keep a number of points in mind.
Make sure your tweezers are sharp. Sharpen the tweezers on a sharp knife if needed. If the tweezers are not sharp then you cannot work wonders either. Also make sure your tweezers have pointed tips.
Epilate when your face is warm. Arrange a warm damp towel or a room where your face can simply warm up. This makes epilating hurt less because the skin is more open.

Determine the right shape of your eyebrows. Do you have PMU? Then it is very easy to remove the hairs outside the lines. Want to choose a shape yourself? Then take your face shape into account. Comb the hairs along with the natural shape.

body.heading: Epilating without tweezers
paragraphs: Epilating without tweezers is possible. But how? You can do all sorts of other forms of hair removal at home. By means of waxing, hot wax or with a razor you can make all the excess hairs in the eyebrows disappear.

body.heading: Epilating with thread
paragraphs: Epilating with thread is a fine piece of craftsmanship. It is virtually unlikely that you would be able to do this on yourself, unless you have become a professional at it.

By means of epilating with thread you actually scrape the hairs with roots out of the skin. We call this scraping because you scrape over the skin with a thin thread. You thereby also pull multiple hairs out of the skin at the same time, so you are done a lot more quickly.

Is epilating with thread painful? Yes, often it is. But it depends on a number of things: do you have a low or high pain threshold, do you have thin or thick hairs and do you have a lot of hairs in the eyebrow. Unfortunately there is also no way of using anaesthetic cream for this method.

body.heading: Epilating without pain
paragraphs: Epilating without pain exists! Which method is that then? Shaving! It may sound enormously scary, but that whole feeling falls away after trying it once.

When shaving or epilating the eyebrow you of course do not use a colossal razor. You use a mini razor — actually a foot blade to remove callus. The blades are extremely small and sharp, perfect therefore for removing small hairs.

How you use such a blade: carefully take the blade out of the packaging; hold the blade firmly on both sides and press it through the middle so you have 2 small blades; the outer sides are the blade sides; place the blade flat and at an angle on the skin and cut with the hairs.

With this technique be extremely careful of pressing too hard on the skin and thereby making cuts. The flatter the blade sits on the skin, the tighter you stretch the skin and the less pressure you give with the blade, the better the result.

permanente-make-up-verwijderen.title: Removing Permanent Makeup
permanente-make-up-verwijderen.excerpt: When you are not happy with your permanent makeup you can have it removed. But what actually happens during laser treatment, and what alternatives are there?
permanente-make-up-verwijderen.author: IZZI Beauty
permanente-make-up-verwijderen.seoDescription: What is the best way to remove permanent makeup? What are the side effects of these treatments and is it even worth it?

paragraphs: When you are not happy with your permanent makeup, or perhaps it is still a shape or colour that was in trend for a while but no longer is, you can of course have it removed. Fortunately everything has become more affordable over the years. Laser treatment used to be extremely expensive. But what actually happens during laser treatment?

body.heading: Removing permanent makeup with laser
paragraphs: When you are no longer happy with the permanent makeup, you can easily have it removed by means of a laser. It costs some time and money but ultimately you usually do achieve the result. Always have your permanent makeup removed by a specialised clinic.

The treatment is not experienced as completely painless. Energy pulses are applied into the skin with a laser. The energy therefore penetrates somewhat deeper into the skin to extract the ink from the skin.

body.heading: Is laser treatment for permanent makeup painful?
paragraphs: Unfortunately the treatment is often experienced as painful. But do not despair! Because the amount that needs to be lasered for an eyebrow is of course fairly small. As a result a treatment does not last very long either. In this way laser treatment is also perfectly manageable.

body.heading: Anaesthetic during laser treatment of permanent makeup
paragraphs: An anaesthetic is usually not used. This is also because the laser pulses penetrate the deeper skin layer, and an anaesthetic cream often only numbs the top layer of the skin. So there is not much point in applying an anaesthetic and in theory it takes longer than the treatment itself lasts. Anaesthetic often needs between 15 and 20 minutes to take effect, and the laser treatment will take perhaps 3 to 5 minutes per eyebrow.

body.heading: Side effects of laser treatment of permanent makeup
paragraphs: Immediately after the treatment you will see that the skin turns white. After about half an hour you will see the pigment of the permanent makeup sitting there again as usual. This is a natural reaction of ink in the skin. After that the skin will feel slightly irritated and be red. This lasts about 24 hours. A slight burning sensation can also appear after about 3 to 7 days.

Between treatments you may not use a tanning bed or sit in the sun. This is because a certain wound does form, and when you go in the sun the wound can become infected or pigment. It is also better not to eat spicy food immediately after the treatment, exercise, or sit in the sauna.

After 24 hours scabs will form on the treated area. This looks a little like the scabs you get when you have just had permanent makeup placed. Make sure you do not pull, scratch or pick at the scabs. Let this process take its course entirely.

body.heading: How many treatments do you need to remove permanent makeup?
paragraphs: On average between 10 and 20 days are needed to be able to see the result. The pigment in the skin is gradually shed through the natural reaction after laser treatment. This simply takes some time.

In addition the lasered area must be able to heal fully before a new treatment can be carried out. On average between 6 and 8 weeks must elapse between each treatment. Approximately 3 to 4 treatments are needed before you achieve the desired result at all.

body.heading: What are the costs of laser treatment of permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Of course this differs at every clinic. We compared 10 different places that are certified in removing permanent makeup. On average the costs at those 10 clinics lie between €75 and €150 per treatment. This is a price based only on removing permanent makeup on the eyebrows.
And as explained earlier you therefore need between 3 and 4 treatments for eyebrows before you achieve the desired result. That then comes to an average of €450.

Some health insurers in the Netherlands reimburse laser treatment of permanent makeup in part. This is only possible with supplementary insurance. We advise you to first call your health insurer before you start a laser treatment.

body.heading: Removing permanent makeup with a saline solution
paragraphs: Is there a way that permanent makeup can be removed without the use of a laser device? Yes, there is! With the same needle as the needle used for pigmenting eyebrows you can apply a saline solution into the skin instead of pigment. Since pigmentation is placed in the top layer of the skin, a saline solution dissolves the pigment.

After the first treatment you already see a clear difference. Multiple treatments are also needed for this solution. The treatment is often not experienced as painful, but very mild. This is because the same device is used, and in the same skin layer.

The nice thing about this treatment is, besides the fact that it is virtually painless, that the permanent makeup only needs to be removed in part, since most clients also choose to have permanent makeup placed again but then with a new desired shape and result.

body.heading: Removing permanent makeup without laser
paragraphs: Is there also a technique coming for removing permanent makeup without a laser being needed? We think so. A painless form and mild side effects after laser treatment would be nice. And just as you now have painless laser hair removal, that will certainly also come for the painless removal of permanent makeup. So far there is nothing groundbreaking besides the methods already mentioned.

body.heading: What may you not do with the Powder Brows after the treatment?
paragraphs: No sauna or steam bath. No swimming. Do not lie in the sun. Do not scratch off scabs. Do not touch the eyebrows with your fingers. Do not have Botox placed.

body.heading: What is the best aftercare to do to help the eyebrows recover optimally?
paragraphs: Clean the eyebrows twice a day with Uni Cura soap and water. Pat the eyebrows dry with a clean towel, do not rub. Apply Bepanthen ointment to the eyebrows 2 to 3 times a day.
Stay out of the sun or use factor 50 sun protection. Do not scratch the scabs off; let them fall off naturally. Do not fill in the eyebrows. Do not apply foundation too close to the eyebrows.
Are you unsure whether you have been given the right advice by the stylist? Then call the salon, or follow the rules above.

body.heading: Frequently asked questions about PMU aftercare
paragraphs: May you apply Vaseline to PMU or not? You may not apply Vaseline to the eyebrows. Vaseline seals the skin, and this slightly hinders healing.

Permanent makeup itches, what can I do? Unfortunately there is not much you can do about this; itching is simply a healthy sign of healing. Try not to scratch anything off and if you really have itch, press the eyebrow in at 1 spot with your nail; this slightly reduces the itch.

May I shower after PMU eyebrows? Yes you may, but do leave the eyebrows completely alone after they have been placed. No hot steam showers for a while and do not wash thoroughly under the shower. Do wash your eyebrows twice a day with water and for example Uni Cura soap.
Exercise after PMU? You may only exercise 24 to 48 hours after the treatment.

body.heading: Healing Powder Brows
paragraphs: Ombré Powder Brows healing day by day is a process that is influenced by factors such as your skin type, aftercare and your body's natural recovery. Here we also share tips for good aftercare and discuss the importance of a touch-up treatment after the first session.
At IZZI Beauty you always receive a free consultation in which we discuss your wishes. So you are not committed to anything and can then make a good choice with confidence.

body.heading: How long does the healing process take?
paragraphs: The healing of the pigmented eyebrows depends on many things: the pH value of the skin, skin characteristic (oil-rich, greasy, dry), alcohol use or smoking, protection in the sun and the aftercare procedure.

The healing process of the eyebrows is therefore not only related to how the stylist places the eyebrows, but especially also to the aftercare. Everyone's skin is different, and therefore so is every healing process. Always follow your specialist's aftercare instructions to support the process and prevent complications.

body.heading: Days 1-3: what can you expect immediately after the treatment?
paragraphs: In the first days after the treatment your eyebrows may look darker than the final result. This is because the pigment is still fresh in the skin and needs to stabilise.
You may experience slight swelling, some redness and a tight feeling. This is normal and often subsides within 24-48 hours. Follow your specialist's aftercare instructions carefully.

body.heading: Days 4-7: the formation of scabs
paragraphs: From day 4 the eyebrows start to form scabs and flakes. This is a natural reaction of your skin to the pigment. The scabs can cause the colour to look uneven, which is normal during this stage.
It is important not to scratch the scabs or remove them prematurely, because this can cause pigment loss. Let the scabs come off on their own for the best result.
After one week the scabs have disappeared for most people and the eyebrows look lighter. This is normal because the pigment is still stabilising.

body.heading: Days 8-14: scabs fall off and peeling begins
paragraphs: In this phase the scabs have usually completely disappeared. The eyebrows may now look lighter, because the skin is regenerating and the pigment still needs to stabilise further.
Some people experience slight peeling, which is also a normal part of the healing process. Avoid heavy skincare products and continue to protect your eyebrows from the sun.

The full healing process on average lies between 4-10 days. But the true colour of the pigment is only visible after 1 full month. After two weeks most eyebrows have fully recovered and the colour starts to come through a little more.

body.heading: After 6 weeks: time for a touch-up treatment
paragraphs: After about 6 weeks it is time for the touch-up treatment. During this session the colour is further perfected and any unevenness is touched up. The healing process after the touch-up usually progresses faster, because the skin is already familiar with the pigment.
You can expect the skin to recover fully within 1-2 weeks. This touch-up treatment is essential to ensure that your eyebrows retain their perfect colour and shape for a long time.
Not everyone's Powder Brows are fully healed within 8 to 9 days. This depends on factors such as the condition of the skin, lifestyle and how strictly the aftercare instructions are followed.

body.heading: Side effects of Ombré Powder Brows
paragraphs: Powder Brows have side effects that are immediately visible or noticeable. That is because the skin is set to work to remove the applied pigment from the skin. This is an entirely natural reaction.

You mainly experience: some redness, slight swelling, tickling (scabs), scabs, dryness, a darker colour, irritation and rapid pigment fading. These side effects are normal and form part of the skin's natural healing process.
To reduce discomforts such as itch or tightness we advise using our aftercare cream. However, avoid scratching scabs, because this can cause pigment loss or scars.
If you notice that the side effects last longer than normal or worsen, contact your specialist for advice.

body.heading: Frequently asked questions about healing
paragraphs: How long does the healing process take? On average 2 weeks for the superficial recovery. The full healing process however lasts 6-8 weeks, during which the colour and shape fully develop.
What should I do if scabs come loose? It is important not to pull scabs off or scratch them. If you remove scabs, you can cause pigment loss or even get scars.
How long do I have to wait to use makeup again? You may only apply makeup after the healing process is fully complete. This usually takes 10-14 days.

Can I exercise during the healing process? It is strongly advised against exercising during the first 7-10 days after your treatment. Sweat can disrupt healing and cause the pigment to be absorbed unevenly.

Why does the colour look lighter after 1 week? During the healing process the skin sheds some of the pigment and scabs and peeling can make the colour temporarily seem less intense. Within 4 to 6 weeks the pigment fully settles into the skin.

permanente-make-up-mislukt.excerpt: Failed permanent makeup is not something you simply get rid of. Just as with a tattoo, the process of removing everything takes a very long time.

body.heading: What can go wrong with permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Failed permanent makeup is not something you simply get rid of. Just as with a tattoo, the process of removing everything takes a very long time. You can never get this gone in one go. So know what you are getting into. Think carefully about whether the salon you are going to is the right one and has enough experience.

You often see that with old permanent makeup the eyebrows look grey and dull. This is mainly because the PMU has been placed too deep in the skin. With pigmentation it is the case that only the first skin layer is pigmented. If you work too deep towards the second, sometimes even the third skin layer, then your permanent makeup becomes greyish. The PMU can also turn red from working too deep.

body.heading: Failed permanent makeup eyeliner
paragraphs: Failed permanent makeup eyeliner is particularly unpleasant, because it directly affects your appearance. A failed eyeliner can for example be uneven, too thick, too thin or even discoloured. This can be due to an incorrect technique, incorrect placement or the use of inferior pigments.

An experienced PMU specialist can assess the failed eyeliner and draw up a treatment plan together with you. Sometimes a correction treatment can help, but in severe cases removal with a laser technique or saline solution is the best option.

body.heading: What can you do if your permanent makeup has failed?
paragraphs: When your permanent makeup has failed, you can always have an expert look at it. An experienced PMU specialist could possibly restore and cover the failed permanent makeup. However, this is not always straightforward. It requires more than one treatment and should only be treated by an experienced specialist.

Many salons focus on placing PMU for clients without old PMU. We are different in this. We want to help people get rid of their old PMU. You can therefore always come by for a consultation. In this we can jointly draw up a treatment plan to remove the old permanent makeup in part or fully.

When the old permanent makeup has been properly removed and has become faint, new permanent makeup can probably already go over it. It depends strongly on how the skin heals. Sometimes you can be left with scars from a poor PMU session.

body.heading: How can you prevent failed permanent makeup?
paragraphs: There are ways to prevent failed permanent makeup. It depends strongly on the salon you go to, whether you have read up on this salon, and who you end up with.

A few tips: check whether the salon is GGD-approved, look at the salon's social media, read reviews, visit the website, ask questions, look at healed work from the salon, compare prices, listen to other people's experiences and go with your feeling.
Follow these steps and put some energy into it before you make a final decision. This way you will probably prevent failed PMU.

body.heading: Removing old or failed permanent makeup
paragraphs: If you are wondering how old or failed PMU is removed, you have probably heard of a laser technique. This technique is becoming increasingly popular for removing old tattoos. If it has been pigmented in the first skin layer, we see it as pigmentation. If your PMU is already very old, it may have been placed deeper than the first skin layer. In this case the process takes longer.

Dissolving permanent makeup with salt: salt dissolves pigment. The nice thing about this technique is that no laser is involved. The salt is pigmented into the skin, comparable to the Powder Brows technique. This treatment is mild. During the dissolving of the old pigment with salt the skin can turn white; the whiter the skin turns, the better the skin will heal and the more old pigment will disappear.

Old PMU unfortunately cannot be dissolved with salt if it has been placed in the third skin layer. The pigment then lies too deep. In this case you have to switch to the laser technique. When you want to remove permanent makeup with a laser technique, the laser will as it were scorch the skin away. This technique is painful and the skin is damaged after the treatment.

permanente-make-up-voor-en-nadelen.title: Permanent makeup advantages and disadvantages
permanente-make-up-voor-en-nadelen.excerpt: Permanent makeup is also called PMU. Officially it is not permanent, because the pigment is placed in the first skin layer. We set out all the advantages and disadvantages.

body.heading: What is permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is also referred to by the abbreviation PMU. Officially it is not permanent because the pigment is placed in the first skin layer, and therefore does not stay in endlessly as with a tattoo (in the 3rd skin layer). Permanent makeup therefore fades after a number of years.

How quickly permanent makeup fades depends on the circumstances and how someone treats it. The following points have an effect on how long the PMU stays: an oily skin, a dry skin, doing a lot of peels, UV radiation, salt water, scrub on the skin, the pigment colour of the PMU and whether it has been placed too deep or not.

All these factors determine whether the permanent makeup stays for a long time or not. Especially the first 2 weeks during the healing process it depends strongly on how you treat it. This is decisive for the rest of the years.

body.heading: Risks of permanent makeup
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is regarded as tattooing, even though it is not applied in the same skin layer. It remains a pigment that is not in a natural way a substance belonging to the body. This means that the body tries to remove the pigment from the skin by means of a natural reaction.

For example, after placing permanent makeup you get scabs. These scabs are formed because the skin has been opened during the treatment, and needs to be closed to restore the skin again. These scabs fall off again after a few days.
A chance of risk from permanent makeup is mainly present in the healing phase of the treatment. This phase consists of the first day through to the fourteenth day after placing the permanent makeup.

Permanent makeup may not be placed if there is: dye allergy, haemophilia, chronic skin disease, contact allergy, diabetes, immune disease or cardiovascular abnormalities. And of course not if you are younger than 16 or are pregnant.

body.heading: Different types of permanent makeup
paragraphs: There are different types of permanent makeup treatments. In addition this also differentiates itself again in techniques.
For example you have permanent makeup that is applied with a needle: Ombré Powder Brows, eyeliner, Faux Freckles, lipliner, Lip Blushing and hairstrokes eyebrows.
And you also have permanent makeup that is applied by means of a blade; this is used for the Microblading technique and with this you can create hairstrokes and feather hairstrokes eyebrows.

body.heading: Applying permanent makeup
paragraphs: All GGD-approved specialists who place permanent makeup know that all ink and pigment substances must meet strict requirements. That is also checked by the Voedsel en Waren Autoriteit.
The place where the permanent makeup is applied is disinfected with an approved disinfectant with an RVG number. The skin is also shaved if necessary; this is done with a disposable blade.

All steps must be carried out as hygienically as possible. All products come from sterile packaging and may not be touched with bare hands. The ink must likewise be sterile. The specialist will wear gloves with the approved GGD numbers. In addition all disposable materials are thrown away immediately after the treatment.

body.heading: Advantages and disadvantages of permanent makeup
paragraphs: Advantages: it saves time in the morning; always beautiful eyebrows, eyeliner or lips; swimming, sauna and exercising with beautiful eyebrows; mild treatment in terms of pain; it looks well-groomed; it often stays for 3-4 years or even longer; concealing small scars; making lips look fuller; concealing unevenness; purchasing less makeup.
Disadvantages: your makeup taste can change after a while; removal takes quite a long time and costs a lot of money; the lightened colour is only visible after 5 years.

Permanent makeup treatments should be carried out virtually painlessly. Have you undergone a painful treatment? Then this can mean that the specialist has not treated in the correct way. Treating too deep causes a grey and dull undertone that only comes to the surface after a while.

body.heading: Rules for permanent makeup
paragraphs: Of course there are rules in place for being able to place permanent makeup and for being able to receive a treatment. For example you must be over 16 years old, you cannot be pregnant during a treatment, and the person who places the permanent makeup must have a certificate from a course and be GGD-approved.

The GGD approval for permanent makeup is easy to find on the website of the RIVM. Here you can search by the name of the salon whether the salon is approved at all. If not, we strongly advise you against going to the chosen salon. You can incur a lot of damage such as scars, infections, incorrectly placed PMU or unhygienic work.

body.heading: What are Faux Freckles?
paragraphs: One of the newest treatments in the world of semi-permanent makeup, the freckle tattoo, is a procedure in which a makeup artist applies pigment to for example your cheeks and nose to give you the perfect freckled look. The number and the location of these cute brown spots on your face is entirely up to you.
Now you finally no longer have to wait for summer and expose yourself to hours and hours of harmful sunlight to get those freckles — and the best part is: you can have them all year round.

body.heading: How does a body tattoo differ from Faux Freckles?
paragraphs: The biggest difference between these two treatments is that ordinary tattoos use permanent ink that also penetrates deeper into your skin, while freckle tattoos use a semi-permanent ink (pigment), which is applied in the first skin layer instead of the third skin layer. Freckle tattoo machines are also smaller and lighter than those used for normal tattooing.

body.heading: How long does a Faux Freckles treatment take?
paragraphs: The procedure usually lasts around 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the number of freckles and colours you want.

body.heading: How is tattooing freckles done?
paragraphs: The first step is always a consultation with the PMU stylist you have chosen, where you discuss the procedure. When you come to your appointment, the stylist will first map your face with a desired number of freckles in the places you want, using a simple pencil. Once you agree that this is the look you had imagined, the procedure begins.

By using a tattoo machine or a stick-and-poke method, the stylist places small freckles in your skin. Using a tattoo needle, each freckle is made by hand, allowing irregular shapes and colours to be formed that look like naturally appearing spots.

Unlike real tattoos in which ink is used, the PMU stylists here use the same pigment that is used for Powder Brows, so the freckles will not be permanent, but will fade over time — lasting up to three to four years, depending on your skin and lifestyle.
The fake freckles should be spread around your cheeks and nose and placed asymmetrically so that they look as natural as possible.

body.heading: Is the procedure painful?
paragraphs: Tattooing your cheeks and nose does indeed sound very painful, but many PMU stylists use an anaesthetic cream to prevent the pain. Our face is rich in nerve endings and therefore the treatment can be a little unpleasant when you do this without anaesthetic. After anaesthetic has been applied and it has properly taken effect, you feel virtually nothing anymore. The treatment is experienced as ticklish.

body.heading: Are there still risks associated with a Faux Freckles treatment?
paragraphs: A potential problem, although very rare, can be an allergic reaction to the dye used for the process. This is easily resolved by carrying out a patch test before the treatment. Fortunately there are different types of pigments, so even if you are allergic to some of them, there are others that can be used.

Very rarely something called granulomas can appear, a type of lumps that form around anything the body considers foreign. These are however extremely rare and can be prevented by simply testing your skin for the pigment before the treatment.
Finally it is very important to find a skilled PMU stylist with experience to carry out this procedure, since it is not easy to recreate the appearance of real beauty marks.

body.heading: Aftercare of Faux Freckles
paragraphs: Unlike Microblading, which involves a longer recovery period, this procedure is not as intense and the aftercare is not as demanding. It is however crucial that you carefully follow the stylist's instructions.

The first rule is: do not scratch the freckles, however itchy they are, because if you do you can remove some of the pigment or cause premature discolouration. Instead use a nourishing recommended cream to soothe your skin.

In addition stick to the normal routine of washing and moisturising your face, and do not wear makeup for a few days until the freckles have healed. In the first days the pigment will be much darker until it is absorbed by your skin. Over the coming weeks you will lose about 40-60% of the original colour intensity.

body.heading: How long does it take for freckle tattoos to heal?
paragraphs: Depending on your skin type and sensitivity, the tattooed freckles can heal between 3 days and two weeks.

In the first few days you experience sensitivity, swelling, redness and possibly itch in the area, all of which is completely normal. Usually the irritation disappears on day 3 or 4. With each following day the pigment will fade and the sensitivity decrease, and within a maximum of two weeks you can apply your foundation.
During this healing process it is also important to stay away from sunlight and use SPF 15 or higher to prevent pigment fading.

body.heading: When should you get a touch-up for Faux Freckles?
paragraphs: Unlike Microblading or Powder Brows which require a mandatory touch-up, the freckle tattoo treatment is usually a one-off appointment.

If however you feel that your pigment has faded too much, or if you want to carry out a correction, this usually happens 6 to 8 weeks after the original treatment. Apart from this your fake freckles usually last between one and three years, depending on your skin type and general lifestyle.
People usually do touch-ups every 12 to 18 months, depending on how quickly your skin absorbs the pigment.

body.heading: What is lip blush?
paragraphs: Lip blush is an evolved semi-permanent treatment in which pigments are placed in the edges and across your lips, making them look fuller. It is often achieved by using a combination of techniques: pigmenting in pixels (applying small dots of pigment).

Lip blush is similar to lip tattooing, but a more advanced and modern option for semi-permanent makeup for lips. Lip Blush is namely placed in a very shallow way. It uses new techniques, more refined organic pigments (often vegan) and improved tools that are gentler on the skin. The result is much more naturally looking lips, without hard lines.

body.heading: What does a Lip Blush treatment look like?
paragraphs: The treatment lasts on average between one and two hours. First you choose the pigment and the shape of your lips with the help and tips of the specialist. She draws the desired shape, so you can indicate adjustments. Then an anaesthetic gel is applied before the treatment to make the procedure less painful.

The pigment is applied with the advanced tattoo-like machine. After the healing period has ended, a touch-up treatment is required to correct any irregularities or add more pigment. You can also change the colour if you decide that the colour you chose at the first treatment is not the right one for you.

body.heading: Is a Lip Blush treatment painful?
paragraphs: No, it is not. The tool used in the treatment is an advanced, digital pen-like device. It does not go as deep into the skin layers as the old-fashioned tattoo tool. In addition the anaesthetic solution is applied before the treatment to prevent possible discomfort. Through the anaesthetic the treatment often honestly feels ticklish and far from painful.

body.heading: Aftercare of lip blush after the treatment
paragraphs: Fortunately lip blush does not need all that much time to heal. During that period it is however important to carefully follow your specialist's instructions.

Do not wear makeup, especially not around and on your lips. Avoid sweating and exposure to the sun. Wash and dry the area gently, without using aggressive cosmetic products. Apply the restorative cream that the PMU specialist has recommended to prevent complications.

Under no circumstances touch the scabs and absolutely do not remove them either. Let them fall off in a natural way to prevent complications. The more you moisturise with the cream, the less trouble you may have with scabs.

body.heading: Why is lip blush tattoo better than lip fillers?
paragraphs: Blushing the lips is a less invasive procedure than fillers, and the result is much more natural. It remains visible longer, the healing process is shorter and it is much easier to correct if something goes wrong. Lip fillers also require a lot of maintenance and need to be topped up regularly.

Lip Blush is also very nice when your lip line or Cupid's bow is not visible, or has less defined lines. You can choose to accentuate the lip line with a lovely soft fade towards the inside of the lip.

body.heading: What is microblading?
paragraphs: Microblading is a technique for applying permanent eyebrows via a small thin blade. Pigment is applied in the cuts so that you can for example imitate small hairs. Microblading is a technique that is placed in the third skin layer, and is often a fairly painful treatment. It is done by hand and not by machine.

The pigment is often applied in the skin when the cuts are well open, and the skin is quite bruised. That can also be painful. Often a so-called pigment mask is also applied, whereby the pigment at the end of the treatment is left to soak into the just-damaged skin for another 10 minutes.

body.heading: How long does microblading last?
paragraphs: Salons often advertise that microblading can last 3 years. However it depends strongly on the skin type you have: greasy, oil-rich, dry or normal. Microblading does not stay well on all skin types. I often see in my salon that microblading on clients has actually only been able to last 6 months to a maximum of 1 year. So you pay a considerable amount for a treatment you only enjoy for a short time.
Besides the fact that the result is short-lived, after the first treatment you have to undergo the unpleasant painful treatment again after 6-8 weeks so that the pigment stays longer.

body.heading: Disadvantages of microblading
paragraphs: Because microblading is often placed in the third skin layer, scar tissue forms in the skin. Scar tissue from microblading can form because the skin has sustained a traumatic and painful wound and automatically wants to recover. This does not succeed in a natural way, and as a result scar tissue forms in the skin: a dense, fairly thick skin that can possibly be bumpy in structure.

You often see that the skin has a red or greyish glow, and the skin is thickened. The skin is also pulled together more tightly by the trauma, which means that all new types of treatments after a similar trauma take poorly on the skin. We often encounter these complaints when people have had microblading in the past; even after 5 years the scar tissue remains very clearly visible.

The problem is namely that the hairstrokes you make through microblading can easily be done by machine. Powder Brows are also made by machine, and with the same machine you can therefore also have the hair-stroke technique placed. Because you choose a machine method, the PMU stylist will not pigment in the third skin layer, but in the first skin layer, as it should be.

body.heading: Why is microblading offered more than Powder Brows?
paragraphs: We have a very simple answer to this: being able to do microblading does not require a large investment. The blade costs barely anything, and the course neither. That is why microblading is offered everywhere. Sometimes even still at a fairly high price as well — just think of the fact that some salons simply charge €550.00 or more.

We still want to emphasise that we have not written this to slam microblading into the ground, because what works for one person may not work for another. And that choice lies entirely with you. We only want to make clear how a treatment proceeds, what the consequences of it are, and that there is simply a more difficult way back.

After a period of greying they can also become red, because red is the last colour to disappear.
In the past, many lip liners, black eyebrows and heavy permanent makeup were placed. Decades later, these clients now mainly have grey and red PMU.

body.heading: Cause of permanent makeup discolouration
paragraphs: Discolouration is mainly caused by the placement method and skin layer used by the stylist. An undertone analysis is very important, because when the undertone of the skin does not match the undertone of the pigment they can negatively reinforce each other.

For pale skin, warm undertones work better. Cool undertones can accentuate the skin's undertone, which makes the pigment look cooler and duller. For a neutral skin, neutral pigments are a better fit, and for a warm skin with freckles a mix of warm and cool pigments works best.

body.heading: PMU eyebrows that have turned red
paragraphs: Red is not always a sign of poor pigment quality. Red is simply the primary colour with the largest molecules — smaller molecules dissolve sooner. This explains why red remains after years. Red colours become visible more quickly with placement that is too deep or too superficial.

everything-about-ombre-powder-brows.title: Everything you need to know about Ombré Powder Brows
everything-about-ombre-powder-brows.excerpt: Ombré powder brows are a semi-permanent eyebrow technique using microneedle pigmentation that lasts 2-3 years. This method creates natural shading through pixel placement.
