body.heading: What are Ombré Powder Brows?
paragraphs: The technique involves placing dots — called pixels — in the desired eyebrow shape to create natural shading with pigment colour. By placing these dots you create a natural shading in a certain pigment colour. The resulting powder effect varies based on pixel size.

Ombré powder brows last approximately 2-3 years, allowing clients to wake up with perfect eyebrows daily. A key characteristic is vague beginning pieces that fade gradually, creating the ombre effect through light pressure and long strokes that space pixels apart, preventing a harsh defined line at the front.

body.heading: What is the difference between microblading and Ombré Powder Brows?
paragraphs: Powder brow technique and equipment differ completely from microblading. Micro blading = micro blade / knife cuts, which involves creating small skin incisions where pigment absorbs. This treatment is often painful and typically remains visible only 6 months.

Ombré powder brows use microneedle pigmentation resembling a tattoo machine. However, a tattoo is applied in the 3rd skin layer, and pigmentation in the 1st skin layer. This superficial placement makes the treatment virtually painless, with some clients sleeping during application.

Microblading creates small lines called hairstrokes for a natural appearance in sparse areas. The result of Ombré Powder Brows is more natural, softer, more powdery and ultimately more suitable for the face.

body.heading: Semi permanent Ombré Brows
paragraphs: Eyebrow trends constantly change. Years ago, ultra-thin eyebrows were fashionable, causing many people to over-pluck hair permanently.

Ombré brows remain semi-permanent because pigmentation is applied superficially in the first skin layer. When pigmented, the skin tries to make the pigment disappear on its own. About 50-60% of the pigment is rejected and disappears after the treatment.

body.heading: Ombré Powder Brows touch up treatment
paragraphs: Following the initial treatment, eyebrow colour decreases 50-60% as skin naturally rejects pigment. The healing process begins immediately with scab formation. You should absolutely not pick or pull off these crusts, to avoid pulling pigment or creating the zebra effect — uneven pigmentation from partially healed areas.

A follow-up treatment determines whether pigment has settled evenly, the shape is permanent, and colour meets client expectations. Everyone experiences it differently after 6-8 weeks. Sometimes there are customers who have nothing left from their first treatment, sometimes there are customers who hardly need a touch up.

body.heading: How long will it take until Ombré Powder Brows are completely healed?
paragraphs: Healing depends on multiple factors: pH value, skin characteristics (oily, dry), alcohol consumption, smoking, sun protection, and aftercare procedures. The healing process of the eyebrows therefore not only has to do with how the stylist places the eyebrows, but also with the aftercare.

Slight swelling, redness, and skin tightness typically disappear within 24-48 hours. The full healing process takes on average between 4-10 days. But the true colour of the pigment is only visible after 1 full month. Follow-up treatment occurs after 6-8 weeks.

body.heading: How can Powder Brows lighten in colour faster?
paragraphs: Several factors accelerate pigment fading: excessive sun exposure, over-exfoliation, using hyperpigmentation-reducing serums, and insufficient skin hydration. Spending time in the tanning bed or full in the sun while sunbathing, sometimes with oil on the skin, can cause the eyebrows to decrease in colour enormously.
The only thing you have to do for optimal preservation of the eyebrows is to protect it with a factor (preferably factor 50) in full sun or under the tanning bed.

body.heading: Who are Powder Brows meant for?
paragraphs: Ombré powder brows work on all skin types: greasy, oily, dry, or average. They suit people lacking natural eyebrow shape. With powder brows, clients gain defined shape and only occasionally epilate hairs outside the defined area.
Can men also get powder brows? Yes. Men and women with sparse or missing eyebrow hair benefit from pixel placement creating natural-looking fullness.

body.heading: Side effects of the Ombré Powder Brows
paragraphs: Side effects occur because skin naturally attempts to remove applied pigment — a normal reaction similar to tattoos or piercings.

Common mild effects include redness, slight swelling, itching (from crusts), crusts, dryness, darker colour, irritation and rapid pigment fading. All the mentioned side effects can be present in mild form. There are hardly any customers who experience the side effects as unpleasant.

failed-permanent-make-up.seoDescription: Failed permanent make-up, how is this possible? What does it look like and how can you undo this? Read everything about failed PMU.

paragraphs: Imagine it happens to you: your permanent makeup fails. The result ends in something you wouldn't want on your face at all. And now it really happened. What now? We inform you in this blog about what can go wrong during permanent make up, and we'll show you what type of solutions there are.

body.heading: Failed permanent make up
paragraphs: Failed permanent makeup is not something you can get rid of just like that. As with a tattoo, the process takes a very long time to remove everything.

Often, old PMU appears grey and dull because pigmentation was placed too deep in the skin. When specialists work beyond the first skin layer, the pigment can turn grey or red, resulting in undesirable outcomes.

body.heading: What can you do if your permanent make up has failed?
paragraphs: An experienced PMU specialist may repair and cover failed permanent makeup, though this requires multiple treatments. We would like to help people get rid of their old PMU through intake consultations to develop treatment plans for partial or complete removal, followed by new application once the skin heals properly.

body.heading: How can you prevent failed permanent make up?
paragraphs: Key prevention steps include: checking GGD approval, reviewing salon social media and reviews, visiting the website, asking questions, examining overall work quality, comparing prices, considering recommendations, and trusting your instincts.

body.heading: Remove old or failed permanent make up
paragraphs: Dissolve permanent make up with salt: salt dissolves pigment in a mild technique without laser involvement. Salt is pigmented into skin similarly to powder brows application. The whiter the skin becomes, the better the skin will heal and the more old pigment will disappear. This method cannot work for PMU placed in the third skin layer.

Solve permanent make-up with laser technique: laser treatment burns the skin, allowing it to repair itself by creating new skin and dissolving lasered pigment. This painful process leaves skin damaged during healing, and complete pigment removal takes considerable time.

pmu-reach-regelement-2022.title: Permanent makeup REACH regulation 2022
pmu-reach-regelement-2022.excerpt: Shaken awake by all the news reports about tattoo and PMU pigments? We explain to you exactly which new rules are coming because of the REACH legislation.
pmu-reach-regelement-2022.author: IZZI Beauty
pmu-reach-regelement-2022.seoTitle: Permanent Makeup REACH Regulation 2022 - IZZI Beauty
pmu-reach-regelement-2022.seoDescription: In the REACH regulation you can find which codes will be banned as of 1 January 2022. A number of PMU / tattoo pigment brands have got to work immediately

body.heading: Which PMU substances are regarded as dangerous in pigments?
paragraphs: There is a difference between tattoo pigments and permanent makeup pigments. Tattoos are placed in the third skin layer, while pigmentation is only applied in the first skin layer. Tattoo pigments are more intensely pigmented, which means adverse side effects can become visible more quickly than with PMU pigments.

Certain chemical substances in the tattoo colours green and blue will be banned as of 1 January 2022 because they are carcinogenic. When someone undergoes a treatment, the consumer must be well informed so that they can make a choice themselves.

The REACH regulation states that the following codes are banned in Europe as of 1 January 2022: blue pigment CI 74160 and green pigment CI 74260. In addition, isopropanol / isopropyl alcohol is also banned, because it can cause severe irritation and allergic reactions.

body.heading: Which permanent makeup pigment brands are permitted?
paragraphs: The following list contains pigment brands that are approved in Europe according to REACH legislation: Labina, Laliqa, Quantum, Ecuri, Sweet Lips, Long Time Liner and Phi pigments.
Pigment brands that are working on releasing a completely new line: Permablend, Swisscolor, Evenflo and Browdaddy.

It is advisable to invest in the right pigments now, so that they do not have to be discarded later. Want to know whether a brand complies with the legislation? Then check the brand's SDS sheet on the website per pigment. This contains the ingredients list. Check whether the banned codes or isopropanol appear in it.

body.heading: What kind of rules are coming according to the GGD and the RIVM?
paragraphs: As a salon owner, a number of adjustments are expected. There is room for a transitional phase because not every salon owner can overhaul everything immediately.

The following rules apply: the NEN-EN standard is designated as the new safety code for tattooing; age limits for PMU and tattoo will be raised; training requirements will be imposed on tattooists; and once every 5 years a refresher course must be taken to maintain professional competence.

body.heading: What can a trainer expect?
paragraphs: A trainer must deliver the learning programme as specified in the document, offer at least one day of practical training, and carry out an assessment by an expert in a suitable environment.

In addition, a trainer must have completed a first-aid course and keep it up to date. The trainer must be well informed about correct risk and aftercare information and be able to explain the intake form point by point.

verschil-microblading-en-powder-brows.title: Difference between microblading and Powder Brows
verschil-microblading-en-powder-brows.excerpt: There is a big difference between microblading and Powder Brows. Not only in terms of sensation, but also in terms of healing and result.
verschil-microblading-en-powder-brows.author: IZZI Beauty
verschil-microblading-en-powder-brows.seoTitle: Difference between Microblading & Powder Brows - IZZI PMU
verschil-microblading-en-powder-brows.seoDescription: The difference between Microblading and Powder Brows is very large. But what exactly are the differences? Both are PMU. Read it here!

body.heading: What are Ombré Powder Brows?
paragraphs: With the Ombré Powder Brows technique the eyebrows are fully shaded with pixels. This specific PMU technique gives a very subtle result because the pigment is not fully saturated, but beautifully distributed. Through the ombré technique the front of the eyebrow becomes gradually a little lighter, so that no hard start to the eyebrows remains visible.

body.heading: What is a microblading treatment?
paragraphs: Microblading is a permanent makeup technique in which hairs are imitated by means of wafer-thin lines that are placed in the skin through the natural eyebrow hairs. This is done with an extremely thin blade (micro-blade) that is covered with pigment. This pigment draws into the skin in the cut hair strokes, leaving lines of pigment behind.

body.heading: Is a microblading treatment painful?
paragraphs: Of course everyone's pain threshold is very personal, however a microblading treatment is often experienced as very painful. We know this from the experience of clients for whom we carry out correction work by placing Powder Brows over microblading.

Because of the blade that is placed in the skin with some pressure and consistency, including anaesthetic that cannot reach the third skin layer, a microblading treatment is therefore often experienced as quite painful. For some even so painful that they no longer want to come back for a touch-up treatment.

body.heading: Is a Powder Brows treatment painful?
paragraphs: An Ombré Powder Brows treatment is virtually painless. Besides the fact that we take all precautionary measures to make a treatment as painless as possible, the treatment is often not experienced as painful at all.

Powder Brows are placed in the first skin layer, and microblading in the third skin layer. This difference, especially in sensation, is enormous. Ombré Powder Brows is often even milder in sensation than plucking. Do you not have this sensation? Then your treatment did not proceed in the right way, regardless of someone's pain threshold.

body.heading: Disadvantages of a microblading treatment
paragraphs: A microblading treatment virtually always causes scars; this is the reason why you can only have a microblading treatment carried out a limited number of times in your life. Scar tissue from microblading can develop after treatments to such an extent that the skin shows enormous thickening. This is something you can no longer reverse.

In addition, a microblading treatment is not suitable for all skin types; on an oily or greasy skin the microblading treatment often does not take. This is because the PMU pigment cannot be processed in the third skin layer in which microblading is placed.

body.heading: Disadvantages of a Powder Brows treatment
paragraphs: Compared with microblading, Ombré Powder Brows have virtually no disadvantages or adverse effects. In the long term powder brows heal much more beautifully, without scar tissue, and unlike microblading you can also have powder brows touched up indefinitely.

An Ombré Powder Brows treatment is often a little more expensive than a microblading treatment. This is mainly because the investment in a machine for Powder Brows is very large, and the microblading investment for both a course and products is often very cheap.

body.heading: Microblading results
paragraphs: A microblading treatment often lasts 1 year, but the eyebrows may only be touched up after 2 years because otherwise the chance of scar tissue becomes even greater.

A microblading treatment often already discolours within a short time after placement to an unwanted colour such as red or grey. This is something that can only be corrected by means of a colour correction with powder brows. We recommend that you only go to a salon that specialises in this.

body.heading: Ombré Powder Brows results
paragraphs: The great advantage of Ombré Powder Brows is that the pigment fades gradually and prevents bald spots in the eyebrows. There is also no skin damage that can flare up, because the powder brows technique is very subtle and is placed in the first skin layer.
Because no skin damage is involved, after years there is no discolouration of the pigment and it also does not change into an unwanted colour.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: The main difference between microblading and Powder Brows is therefore that with powder brows no scar tissue develops, it is suitable for every skin type and it mainly fades in a beautiful way in the skin without discolouration.
In addition, a microblading treatment is often very painful, while Ombré Powder Brows is often experienced as milder than plucking. Prevent scars and unwanted discolouration and choose Powder Brows.

ombre-powder-brows-genezingsproces.title: Ombré Powder Brows healing process
ombre-powder-brows-genezingsproces.excerpt: The healing process accounts for 50% of the retention of the pigment. Half of the result is therefore influenced by the way you treat the Powder Brows after they have been placed.
ombre-powder-brows-genezingsproces.author: IZZI Beauty
ombre-powder-brows-genezingsproces.seoTitle: Ombré Powder Brows Healing Process - IZZI Beauty PMU
ombre-powder-brows-genezingsproces.seoDescription: The Ombré Powder Brows healing process consists of different phases. Which phase belongs to which part of the Ombré Powder Brows healing?

body.heading: How long does it take before Powder Brows are fully healed?
paragraphs: The Ombré Powder Brows healing process differs from person to person. This is because everyone is unique in their healing process. We can, however, speak of an average number of days or weeks in which certain points of the process occur.

The Powder Brows are often a little more intense in colour around day 1 and 2 after the treatment. That is because the wound of the eyebrows hardens, which makes the colour more intense. You often have scabbing between 4 to 6 days.

Around day 7 or 8 after the treatment the pigment often fades away strongly. This is because the skin is now reacting to the pigment that is in the skin layer and wants to work it out, given that it is not a natural substance of its own. Around day 9 or 10 you will notice that the colour of the Powder Brows largely comes back again.

If your recovery is perhaps a little slower, it may be that you only see a strong reduction in the pigment around 14 days. In both cases the recovery process is equally good; so it is not the case that when the healing process recovers more quickly, this is better for the final result.

body.heading: How long must Powder Brows not get wet?
paragraphs: It is a big myth that Powder Brows must not get wet after the treatment. Besides being a myth, it is also a major risk not to get them wet. In the Netherlands we have the GGD and the RIVM, which have ensured that all PMU and tattoo salons are obliged to follow the Dutch aftercare and to give this to the client.

In our salon we notice that many people are not familiar with this scripted aftercare form. Very unfortunate, because poor aftercare can not only cause infections, but also the compulsory use of antibiotics, up to even the fact that sometimes the PMU can no longer be restored.

For the first 2 days you must wash the Powder Brows very thoroughly with unscented soap and normal to lukewarm water. You can see Powder Brows as an open wound; when a wound is very susceptible to bacteria, you also like to keep the wound clean, don't you?

body.heading: Powder Brows after a week
paragraphs: The Ombré Powder Brows healing process is ultra important for retaining optimal pigment until your next appointment. Ombré Powder Brows after a week look a little lighter. That is because the skin gives a natural defence reaction. The skin wants to make sure the pigment is pushed out. As a result the colour of the pigment fades away as standard.

Sometimes we still get an emergency phone call from clients who have briefly forgotten that this would happen. Two days after this phone call everything is fine again. But we understand that you can sometimes get a bit of a fright.

body.heading: Powder Brows peeling
paragraphs: Ombré Powder Brows remains a form of permanent makeup; the skin is, as it were, broken, so that the wound then has to recover. Because pigment is also used you will notice that the Powder Brows will start to peel after a while. This process often starts after 4-6 days if you have a fast healing process. If you have a slow healing process, the peeling sometimes only starts after 8 to 9 days.

Because flakes often do not fall off entirely gradually and smoothly, you will notice that you get a kind of zebra effect on your eyebrows. Fortunately this often lasts only a very short time. If the flakes suddenly start to appear in the morning, it could well be that the flakes are already completely gone the next day.

permanente-make-up-tijdens-zwanger.title: Permanent makeup during pregnancy
permanente-make-up-tijdens-zwanger.excerpt: During pregnancy the hormone balance and the body change considerably. Permanent makeup during pregnancy is therefore not recommended because of health risks.
permanente-make-up-tijdens-zwanger.author: IZZI Beauty
permanente-make-up-tijdens-zwanger.seoTitle: Permanent Makeup During Pregnancy? Yes or No?
permanente-make-up-tijdens-zwanger.seoDescription: Is permanent makeup permitted during pregnancy? Why you should or should not have permanent makeup placed during pregnancy. Read here!

body.heading: What happens to permanent makeup pigment during pregnancy?
paragraphs: During a pregnancy a great deal changes in the body. The body works harder to provide the baby with everything, and about 6 litres of extra blood is produced.

The hormone balance changes considerably during pregnancy. This affects how permanent makeup is absorbed, since hormones are partly responsible for pigment absorption. This leads to a negative effect on the retention of permanent makeup pigment.
Normally one loses 40-60% of the pigment after a first PMU treatment, but during pregnancy this can rise to more than 70-80%.

body.heading: Why do many salons not place PMU if you are pregnant?
paragraphs: Many salons refuse permanent makeup during pregnancy because long-term effects on the foetus have not been studied. PMU pigment reaches the bloodstream and can thus end up with the child.
According to the GGD and RIVM, permanent makeup during pregnancy is virtually forbidden, regardless of how far the pregnancy has progressed.

body.heading: What is a major risk of placing permanent makeup during pregnancy?
paragraphs: The greatest risk is infection. Hormonal changes make the body more sensitive to certain chemical substances, including pigment. Treating an infection requires antibiotics, which cannot be administered during pregnancy.

body.heading: Why not place permanent makeup while breastfeeding?
paragraphs: The hormone balance remains unstable for months after the birth. This is often referred to as 9 months up, 9 months down.
During breastfeeding, pigment can pass to the baby via the breast milk. The long-term effects have not been studied, so permanent makeup is also not recommended during breastfeeding.

make-up-na-powder-brows-behandeling.title: Make-up after a powder brows treatment
make-up-na-powder-brows-behandeling.excerpt: You have just undergone a powder brows treatment but wonder whether you may apply make-up. And if so, after how long? We explain it.
make-up-na-powder-brows-behandeling.author: IZZI Beauty
make-up-na-powder-brows-behandeling.seoTitle: Make-up after a powder brows treatment - IZZI Beauty
make-up-na-powder-brows-behandeling.seoDescription: Make-up after a powder brows treatment, after how long may you use make-up again? Read all about it in the blog!

body.heading: Why may I not wear make-up after a powder brows treatment?
paragraphs: A Powder Brows treatment is placed by means of pigment in the first skin layer. This means that the skin is, as it were, opened so that pigment can be left behind. When the skin is open it must be regarded and above all treated as an open wound.

Placing make-up in an open wound is of course not beneficial for the recovery of the powder brows. Make-up can be applied with dirty brushes and unclean fingers, and when the make-up can soak into the wound all day it only attracts more bacteria.

Besides the fact that make-up is not permitted on new powder brows, it is also certainly not permitted to use products other than water and fragrance-free soap. Cleansing wipes, milk, oil or make-up remover are therefore also a real no-go for permanent makeup.

body.heading: When may I apply make-up again after powder brows?
paragraphs: This answer is fortunately simpler than it seems: when the wound is fully healed and no more scabs are visible, the wound is, as it were, a new skin. As soon as this is the case you may therefore start using make-up again if you wish.

We do advise you to really only do this after 7-9 days after the powder brows treatment. But not everyone has a fast recovery process. With some clients we only see scabs appear after a full week. Let the permanent makeup heal fully and give it time.

body.heading: When may I wash my face after powder brows?
paragraphs: It is important to follow the correct instructions regarding aftercare for Ombré Powder Brows. You can quite easily pick up an infection if you do not follow the aftercare in the right way.

Some salons advise you mainly not to touch the powder brows and to leave them completely dry for 1 to 2 weeks. This is not the correct advice. The GGD has in fact compiled guidance to wash the open wound thoroughly for the first 2 days with lukewarm water and fragrance-free soap. You do this in the morning and in the evening. Gently, of course.

In addition you must also apply a nourishing, unscented healing cream for at least the first 7 days. Washing your face after powder brows is therefore permitted again virtually immediately after the treatment. But you may not use another foam wash or facial cleanser that contains oil or fragrance.

body.heading: When may I exercise after a powder brows treatment?
paragraphs: Do not exercise until at least 3 days after the powder brows treatment. We advise this because sweat contains salt. Salt literally dissolves the pigment in the newly pigmented eyebrows. This can create gaps in the colour of the powder brows. This is sometimes still difficult to restore with a touch-up treatment.

body.heading: How long must powder brows not get wet in the shower?
paragraphs: As we have already explained above, it is therefore a myth that powder brows must not get wet. Showering with powder brows is also permitted virtually immediately after the treatment.

You do need to be careful with the temperature. Because the sauna, the swimming pool and the tanning bed are also not permitted, mainly because of the heat, a hot shower after placing powder brows is also not permitted. Prefer to shower a little shorter and especially with lukewarm water.

lip-blush-pmu.title: Lip Blush PMU
lip-blush-pmu.excerpt: Lip Blush is a relatively new permanent makeup treatment that has become very popular in the Netherlands in a short time. The treatment uses micropigmentation.
lip-blush-pmu.author: IZZI Beauty
lip-blush-pmu.seoTitle: Lip Blush - the No. 1 PMU treatment in the Netherlands!
lip-blush-pmu.seoDescription: Lip Blush is a form of semi-permanent makeup. The treatment is painless and you enjoy lip blush for a very long time. Read more here!

body.heading: What is Lip Blush?
paragraphs: Lip blush is applied using semi-permanent makeup. Through micropigmentation, colour is pigmented into the skin layer of the lips in small pixels. These are tiny dots of colour that are left behind.

Lip Blush can adjust the shape of your natural lips, add more volume or more warmth. Asymmetrical lips can often be made symmetrical with lip blush as well. This is why permanent makeup for lips has become very popular in a short time.

body.heading: Does lip blush PMU hurt?
paragraphs: I can imagine: having permanent makeup applied to your lips seems relatively painful. However, a lip pigmentation treatment is virtually painless provided it is carried out in the right way. Of course everyone's pain threshold is different and one person may still be more sensitive to the pain. In 95% of our treatments we find that the lip tattoo is applied completely painlessly.

body.heading: How long does the lip blush result remain visible?
paragraphs: On average, lip blush remains visible for up to 5 years. Of course the colour fades over time, but you can have it touched up. A touch-up for lip PMU can already be scheduled after a year or 1.5 years. That is also because you yourself quickly get used to a certain colour. If you want the lip blush colour to be more intense, you need to come in for a touch-up treatment sooner.

body.heading: Which colour of PMU lips can I have?
paragraphs: Lip pigmentation is often underestimated because many photos are posted on social media in which the lip tattoo has just been applied and has not yet healed. Because the skin still needs to heal for 7-9 days at the visible surface, the pigment will fade by 40-60%. Healed lip blush results are unfortunately shown too little.

Of course there are people who really ask for a very intense colour that always remains visible, such as red. But most clients who choose lip blush really want something natural or a bit more volume and warmth, but certainly not a very intense colour.

To choose a lip blush colour we use a range of different colours that we place on the skin. We do this because this way the undertone of a pigment colour can become clearly visible on the skin. If the pigment colour does not match the skin, we advise against choosing those colours.

body.heading: How long does lip pigmentation take?
paragraphs: A lip pigmentation treatment often takes between 1.5 and 3 hours, depending on how experienced the PMU specialist is. Sometimes more work also needs to be done because asymmetry has to be corrected. And sometimes someone can have a lot of filler in her lips, which means the surface on which to apply lip blush is much larger.

Our lip pigmentation treatment often takes 1.5 hours. That is because of our experience, our own techniques and the special needles we use. It is no coincidence that we also offer lip blush training courses to others.

micro-scalp-pigmentatie.title: Micro scalp pigmentation permanent makeup
micro-scalp-pigmentatie.excerpt: Micro scalp pigmentation is the pigmentation of the scalp using semi-permanent makeup, in which small pixels are applied that look like trimmed hairs.
micro-scalp-pigmentatie.author: IZZI Beauty
micro-scalp-pigmentatie.seoTitle: Micro Scalp Pigmentation Permanent Makeup treatment
micro-scalp-pigmentatie.seoDescription: Micro Scalp Pigmentation is the pigmentation of the scalp using semi-permanent makeup. Is this something for you? Read it in the blog!

body.heading: What is micro scalp pigmentation?
paragraphs: Micro scalp pigmentation is the pigmentation of the scalp using semi-permanent makeup. Small pixels are applied that look like trimmed hairs. This can be placed to fill in the hair or over the entire head, depending on the wishes and baldness.

Micro scalp pigmentation creates the illusion of greater hair density by covering the scalp with pixels of PMU. The pigments are placed shallowly in the skin, which means the treatment feels very mild and is therefore very easy to tolerate.

The treatment cannot be compared with tattooing the head; tattoos are placed quite deeply into the skin and with semi-permanent makeup we do this very superficially. This ensures that the pigments can never discolour.

body.heading: Is micro scalp pigmentation only suitable for men?
paragraphs: Micro scalp pigmentation is suitable for both men and women. Of course there are not many women who choose scalp pigmentation over the entire head, but this is possible as well. Women more often choose scalp pigmentation to fill in small areas of the scalp.

In addition, scalp pigmentation can also be carried out on people who suffer from alopecia. Alopecia is a condition in which the hair falls out. With alopecia totalis the hair disappears almost everywhere. Micro scalp pigmentation can then be a beautiful solution without any underlying hair follicles being damaged.
Men more often choose scalp pigmentation to give their hairline more optical definition, to fill in receding hairlines or to give a number of bald spots more colour.

body.heading: Can you still have long hair with scalp pigmentation?
paragraphs: Micro scalp pigmentation consists of small dots or pixels that give certain bald spots a fuller effect. Because the dots are placed superficially and are not 3D like real hair, it only fills in illusionally. So it gives a fuller effect but it is certainly not comparable with longer hair.
It is therefore often most beautiful to keep the hair short and trimmed. For women we can fill in empty spots more between long hair, so that it is less noticeable that hair is missing.

body.heading: For whom is scalp pigmentation not intended?
paragraphs: Not everyone can undergo a scalp pigmentation treatment. Scalp pigmentation cannot be applied if you suffer from diabetes, are currently undergoing chemotherapy, suffer from an immune disease, use blood-thinning medication, are pregnant, have active skin diseases, have active psoriasis on the treated area, have burnt skin or are using antibiotics.

In addition, the semi-permanent makeup cannot always be applied when certain medications are being used. Are you unsure whether the treatment is suitable for you? Then ask the practitioner for more information before you book a treatment.

body.heading: Which problems can micro scalp pigmentation solve?
paragraphs: Micro scalp pigmentation can solve quite a lot of problems and take away your insecurity. Scalp pigmentation can help with alopecia, total baldness, scars on the head, thin hair, an irregular hairline, a non-symmetrical hairline, bald spots and receding hairlines.

body.heading: How long does scalp pigmentation remain visible?
paragraphs: Just as with other permanent makeup treatments, it depends on many factors. Normally scalp pigmentation remains visible for about 4-8 years. In some cases even around 10 years. When the aftercare has been poorly followed, you may lose the pigmentation on the head more quickly.

Eventually permanent makeup always fades. This happens because the skin slowly but surely sheds the pigment. We work in the first layer of skin with scalp pigmentation, and when a real tattoo is placed you work in the third layer of skin.

Why is scalp pigmentation not tattooed instead of pigmented? That is because when you do go into the third layer of skin on the head, you will eventually always end up with discolouration of the pigment. Walking around with blue, purple or red pigment on your head is of course something nobody wants.

body.heading: How does a scalp pigmentation treatment proceed?
paragraphs: Of course it is first important to go through whether this treatment is suitable for you. We do this by means of a consultation. If treatment ultimately takes place, these consultation costs are deducted from the full treatment price.

In a treatment you receive 2 sessions. The first session always consists of measuring out the areas that will need to be filled. The second session consists of filling in the first, healed session, and then also intensifying where needed.

After the first scalp pigmentation session you lose about 40% to 60% of the pigment. After the second session you lose only about 20 to 30%. That is because the pigment is already known to the skin. Count on it that when you have the entire head pigmented you will certainly spend about 6 to 8 hours per session.

body.heading: Is scalp pigmentation a painful treatment?
paragraphs: It seems self-evident that it would be a painful treatment, thinking of the fact that you are constantly placing a little dot on an often sensitive scalp with a needle. But the treatment is often experienced as very mild.

How can that be? Semi-permanent makeup for scalp pigmentation is always applied in the first layer of skin. To compare: a tattoo is placed in the third layer of skin. In addition, anything that goes into the third layer of skin often cannot be numbed with a cream either, and anything that is placed in the first layer of skin can.

permanente-make-up-zwangerschap.title: Permanent makeup if you are pregnant
permanente-make-up-zwangerschap.excerpt: Permanent makeup is a popular cosmetic treatment in which pigment is introduced into the skin. Many women wonder whether this is safe during pregnancy.
permanente-make-up-zwangerschap.author: IZZI Beauty
permanente-make-up-zwangerschap.seoTitle: Having permanent makeup applied during pregnancy
permanente-make-up-zwangerschap.seoDescription: Permanent makeup during pregnancy, is this even possible and why or why not? Read all about it in our blog!

body.heading: What is permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is a form of tattooing in which pigments are introduced into the skin to create a long-lasting cosmetic result. It is often applied to the eyebrows, lips and eyes to create a natural-looking effect.

body.heading: Is permanent makeup during pregnancy safe?
paragraphs: In general it is advised against having permanent makeup applied during pregnancy because insufficient research into the safety of pigments is available. There are concerns that pigments can reach the foetus via the bloodstream.

When pigments enter the bloodstream, they also reach the foetus. Insufficient research shows what pigment means for a foetus. As a precaution, IZZI Beauty does not apply permanent makeup on pregnant clients.
The skin of pregnant women is more sensitive and the healing process can proceed differently. Hormonal changes can affect the colour quality and cause pigments to fade more quickly.

body.heading: When can permanent makeup be applied?
paragraphs: Permanent makeup can be applied after pregnancy, once the body has fully recovered. It is advised to wait until the baby is at least nine months old, so that hormones normalise.
It is also advised against during breastfeeding because pigments can be passed on to the child via breast milk.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: It is advised against having permanent makeup applied during pregnancy because of unknown risks and a more sensitive skin. Waiting until full recovery after childbirth is recommended, including following the aftercare instructions.

hoe-kan-je-pmu-corrigeren.title: How can you correct PMU? Different ways
hoe-kan-je-pmu-corrigeren.excerpt: Are you not satisfied with your permanent makeup and do you want to have it corrected? Don't worry, there are options available to correct your PMU.
hoe-kan-je-pmu-corrigeren.author: IZZI Beauty
hoe-kan-je-pmu-corrigeren.seoTitle: How can you correct PMU? - Different ways!
hoe-kan-je-pmu-corrigeren.seoDescription: How can you have PMU corrected? Correcting or restoring PMU can be done in different ways. Here you can read all about it!

body.heading: Why might you need a PMU correction?
paragraphs: There are various reasons why you might want to have your PMU corrected. It may be that the colour of the PMU has faded or that the PMU has been applied unevenly, making it look unnatural. Sometimes the PMU can even become distorted or fall outside the shape, giving it a messy appearance. Fortunately there are ways to solve these problems.

body.heading: How can you correct PMU?
paragraphs: The first step is to find a specialised professional who is trained in correcting PMU. This professional will assess your skin and PMU to determine which correction method is best for you.

Reapplying the PMU: if the PMU has faded or has been applied unevenly, the trained professional can reapply the PMU. This can mean that pigment is added to strengthen the colour or that the shape is adjusted. It is important to have this done by an experienced PMU stylist.

Laser treatment: this method is used to remove or fade the PMU, so that the trained professional can apply a new PMU. Laser treatment can require multiple sessions and can be a little painful. Nowadays IZZI Beauty works with the Pico Laser, which removes the old PMU very quickly and a lot less painfully.
Camouflaging: if your PMU cannot be corrected with the methods above, the professional can camouflage it using a skin-coloured pigment. This can help to hide the PMU and give a natural appearance.

body.heading: What can you expect during a PMU correction process?
paragraphs: The process of correcting PMU can vary, depending on the method that is used and the extent of the correction. In general the trained professional will assess your skin and PMU to determine which method is best for you.

During the process there may be some discomfort, but the trained professional will apply numbing cream to reduce the discomfort. After the correction the healing process will take about two weeks, during which instructions must be followed to ensure that the skin heals properly.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: If you are not satisfied with your PMU, there are options available to correct PMU. It is important to find a trained professional who has experience in correcting PMU and to discuss which method is best for you.

When making an appointment, make sure that the PMU stylist also has options for other treatments. But keep in mind that when you book directly with a good PMU stylist, the chance is small that you will need to have it corrected.

permanente-make-up-na-een-week.title: Permanent makeup after one week
permanente-make-up-na-een-week.excerpt: As a professional permanent makeup artist I often get the question of what you can expect during the healing process after you have had PMU applied.
permanente-make-up-na-een-week.author: IZZI Beauty
permanente-make-up-na-een-week.seoTitle: Permanent Makeup After One Week - IZZI Beauty
permanente-make-up-na-een-week.seoDescription: A week after a PMU treatment you see the first result. The scabs have disappeared and the colour looks lighter, but this still recovers.

body.heading: Introduction to permanent makeup (PMU)
paragraphs: PMU, also known as micropigmentation, is a cosmetic tattooing technique in which pigments are applied in the upper layer of the skin and the illusion of makeup is created. PMU can be used to enhance eyebrows, eyeliner, lip colour and even a more defined hairline.
The procedure is becoming increasingly popular because of the long-lasting results, which can last up to three years, and the convenience of not having to apply makeup every day.

body.heading: What can you expect during the first week of PMU healing?
paragraphs: After you have had PMU applied, the first week of healing is crucial for the best possible results. During this period it is common to experience swelling, redness and sensitivity in the treated area.

The pigment may also look darker than expected, but that is normal and will fade over time. It is important not to touch the treated area, not to pick at scabs and not to expose it to direct sunlight during the first week.

body.heading: Tips for a faster and more comfortable recovery from PMU
paragraphs: There are several things you can do to speed up the healing process and make it more comfortable. First: on the day of the procedure, apply an ice pack to the treated area every hour for 10-15 minutes. This helps to reduce the swelling and discomfort.
Second: avoid heavy exercise, hot baths, saunas and steam rooms for at least a week after the procedure. Finally, avoid using makeup or skincare products on the treated area until it is fully healed.

body.heading: The importance of the right aftercare for PMU
paragraphs: Good aftercare is essential for the best possible results and to prevent infections. After the PMU treatment it is important to keep the treated area clean and dry.

Use a gentle, fragrance-free cleanser to clean the area twice a day and pat it dry with a clean towel. Apply a thin layer of aftercare ointment, such as Bepanthen or Laliqa PMU Butter, to the treated area to keep it hydrated and protected.

body.heading: What is normal and what is not?
paragraphs: During the first week of PMU healing it is normal to experience some discomfort and to see changes in the treated area. However, there are some signs that may indicate an infection or other complications.
These include excessive redness, swelling, leakage or fever. If you notice any of these symptoms, contact your PMU specialist or a GP immediately.

body.heading: Frequently asked questions about PMU aftercare and recovery
paragraphs: How long does it take for PMU to heal? PMU usually heals after 7-10 days. The healing process can however vary, depending on the treated area, the individual healing process and the aftercare routine.
Can I wear makeup after I have had PMU done? It is recommended not to wear makeup on the treated area for at least a week after the procedure.
Can I exercise after a PMU treatment? Strenuous exercise, hot baths, saunas and steam rooms should be avoided for at least a week after the procedure to prevent sweating and infection.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: Although the first week of PMU healing can be uncomfortable and discouraging, good aftercare can ensure the best possible results. PMU is a great investment for anyone looking for long-lasting, easy makeup.
With a little patience and the right aftercare you can enjoy the benefits of PMU for years. Do not hesitate to contact your PMU specialist if you have any concerns.

permanente-make-up-blijft-niet-zitten.title: Permanent makeup does not stay in place
permanente-make-up-blijft-niet-zitten.excerpt: Permanent makeup is a popular cosmetic treatment, but the pigment does not always stay in place well. This article examines the main causes and solutions.
permanente-make-up-blijft-niet-zitten.author: IZZI Beauty

permanente-make-up-blijft-niet-zitten.seoDescription: Are you looking for a solution to always look your best without having to apply makeup every day? Then permanent makeup

body.heading: The quality of the pigment
paragraphs: One of the main reasons why permanent makeup does not stay in place is the quality of the pigment that is used. Cheaper pigments are often of lower quality and contain fewer colour pigments. As a result the pigment can fade more quickly and the result can be less beautiful than when using higher-quality pigments.

body.heading: The skills of the specialist
paragraphs: In addition, the skill of the specialist can also play a role in whether or not permanent makeup stays in place. A good specialist not only has knowledge of the right pigments, but also of the right techniques to introduce the pigments in the right way.

If the pigments are not applied at the right depth in the skin, the pigment will fade more quickly. A good specialist will also take the client's skin condition into account and choose the best technique for the desired result.

body.heading: The client's skin condition
paragraphs: In addition, the client's skin condition also plays a role in whether or not permanent makeup stays in place. Oily skin, for example, can hold pigment less easily than dry skin.

It may also be that the client's skin is too thin for permanent makeup, which means the pigment does not stay in place well. A good specialist will always check the client's skin condition before the treatment is started.

body.heading: The client's aftercare
paragraphs: Lastly, the client's aftercare is important for the retention of permanent makeup. After the treatment it is important to follow the specialist's instructions.
This includes avoiding makeup during the first days, applying cream regularly and avoiding exposure to sun, sauna and swimming pool. Without good aftercare the pigment can fade more quickly.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: There are various reasons why permanent makeup does not stay in place, including the quality of the pigment, the skills of the specialist, the client's skin condition and the client's aftercare.

permanente-make-up-vereist-nazorg.seoDescription: Beautiful permanent makeup goes hand in hand with the right aftercare. Permanent makeup aftercare is required. Read everything you need here!

body.heading: What is permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is a form of cosmetic pigmentation. We apply pigment in the skin to improve colour and shape in a way that suits your face. Popular treatments are eyebrows, eyeliner, lips and Faux Freckles (freckles), which nowadays are impossible to imagine being without.
The goal of PMU is to enhance your natural appearance — without it being noticeable that you have had something done.

body.heading: Why aftercare after PMU is essential
paragraphs: Your skin is vulnerable after a PMU treatment. How you deal with that largely determines the end result.

Recovery and healing: your skin needs the time and rest to heal properly. That means no scratching, keeping it clean and protecting it against external influences. With the right care you prevent inflammation, scars and pigment loss.

Colour retention: PMU fades naturally through skin renewal, sunlight and skincare products. But without good aftercare it fades faster than necessary. Always use a sunscreen with at least SPF 30, preferably 50. And avoid products such as scrubs, acids and peels in the first weeks.
Fewer touch-up treatments needed: the better you look after your skin, the longer you enjoy the result. Aftercare can considerably extend the lifespan of your PMU.
Health and safety: poor aftercare can lead to infections or skin problems. That is why official guidelines have been drawn up in the Netherlands by the RIVM and the GGD.

body.heading: What should you do after a PMU treatment?
paragraphs: Cleansing: clean the treated area twice a day (morning and evening) with lukewarm or cold water and a mild, fragrance-free soap. Then gently pat it dry. No rough towels or rubbing.

Hydrating: after cleansing, apply an aftercare cream to the area. Coconut oil or shea butter works well because these nourish the skin without irritating it. The better you hydrate the skin, the fewer flakes you will get.
Leave it alone: during healing, small flakes often appear. Leave them alone. Scratching can cause pigment loss and leads to uneven healing.
No makeup: do not apply makeup to the treated area in the first week. Also no foundation or BB cream near, for example, your eyebrows.
Avoid the sun: UV radiation fades pigment, especially on eyebrows. As a result they can look grey over time. Stay out of the sun and use sunscreen with a high SPF as soon as your skin allows it.
Follow your specialist's instructions: every treatment is different. Your specialist knows your skin and knows which approach works best.

body.heading: How often is a touch-up needed?
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is not literally permanent. Most treatments need a touch-up after 6 to 8 weeks to keep the result sharp. After that it is advisable to schedule an annual refresh treatment.
How often that is really needed depends on your skin type, lifestyle and how well you apply the aftercare.

body.heading: Common mistakes (and how you prevent them)
paragraphs: We often see that people make these mistakes just after the treatment: using makeup again too soon, pulling off flakes, not applying sunscreen, going to the sauna, swimming pool or sunbed in the first week, and not using a hydrating cream.
By dealing with this consciously, you give your skin the chance to heal in a beautiful, healthy way. Do you have questions about aftercare after a PMU treatment? Then contact your specialist.

wat-als-permanente-make-up-is-mislukt.title: What if permanent makeup has gone wrong?
wat-als-permanente-make-up-is-mislukt.excerpt: Permanent makeup can sometimes go wrong. This article covers six possible solutions, from consulting specialists to laser treatments.
wat-als-permanente-make-up-is-mislukt.author: IZZI Beauty
wat-als-permanente-make-up-is-mislukt.seoTitle: What if permanent makeup has gone wrong? - IZZI Beauty
wat-als-permanente-make-up-is-mislukt.seoDescription: What to do if permanent makeup has gone wrong. Unfortunately there is always a chance this can happen to you. How can you move forward when this is the case?

paragraphs: Eyebrows define someone's facial expression, but when permanent makeup does not go according to plan, there are several steps you can take. This article explores all possible recovery solutions.

body.heading: 1. Consult a professional PMU specialist or clinic
paragraphs: It is important to approach an experienced PMU specialist. They can share their experience and advise on the best approach for your situation.

body.heading: 2. Camouflage techniques
paragraphs: Sometimes unsuccessful permanent makeup can be camouflaged with makeup products such as concealers and eyebrow pencils. These can help improve the shape and cover unwanted lines, provided the colour matches the face well.

body.heading: 3. Laser treatment
paragraphs: Laser technology can remove or fade permanent makeup. This is, however, a slow process that costs time and money. IZZI Beauty works with the pico laser, the latest laser technology, which treats specific areas.

body.heading: 4. Chemical peels
paragraphs: Chemical peels fade permanent makeup by treating the top layer of the skin. This procedure must be carried out by a dermatologist. Chemical peels must not be applied during the first 14 days after treatment.

body.heading: 5. Skin care and healing
paragraphs: Good skin care around the eyebrows is essential. Hydration, sun protection and soothing creams help reduce inflammation. A good-quality aftercare butter is recommended.

body.heading: 6. Consult a psychologist
paragraphs: Unsuccessful permanent makeup can cause emotional stress. A psychologist can help you process this impact and develop coping strategies.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: When permanent makeup has been carried out incorrectly, patience and careful consideration are essential. Always consult professionals with experience in PMU corrections to restore the beauty of your eyebrows.

airbrush-brows.seoDescription: In a few years, Airbrush Brows will be an inseparable part of our beauty landscape. Right now, brow lifts, Powder Brows and henna brows are hot!

body.heading: What are Airbrush Brows?
paragraphs: Airbrush Brows says it all: an eyebrow technique that uses paint — in this case henna — and air, creating pressure on the airbrush device so that the henna is applied to the surface.
This new technique can be applied together with a brow lift, in which setting lotions are used to place the eyebrow hairs in a particular shape.

body.heading: How long can you enjoy Airbrush Brows?
paragraphs: On average, Airbrush Brows last around 7 days. The eyebrow hairs themselves are not dyed, but the facial skin is dyed by the henna. The duration can vary depending on how quickly the henna releases from the skin and how you care for the skin.

body.heading: When can you not have Airbrush Brows applied?
paragraphs: IZZI Beauty uses only airbrush henna from the brand Laliqa, which sells water-based henna with minimal irritating ingredients. Airbrush Brows are not recommended in cases of psoriasis, eczema around the eyebrows, after sunburn, or with an extremely sensitive skin.

body.heading: What is the difference between Airbrush Brows and Powder Brows?
paragraphs: Airbrush Brows are surface-level henna eyebrows that last around 7 days. Powder Brows are applied with a small needle into the first layer of the skin and last around 3-4 years.
Airbrush Brows can serve as a test option before choosing permanent Powder Brows.

wat-zijn-powder-brows.title: What are Powder Brows?
wat-zijn-powder-brows.excerpt: Are you tired of filling in your eyebrows every day? Have you had enough of the fuss with pencils, gels and powders? Then Powder Brows may well be the solution.
wat-zijn-powder-brows.author: IZZI Beauty
wat-zijn-powder-brows.seoTitle: #1 What are Powder Brows? - Permanent makeup technique
wat-zijn-powder-brows.seoDescription: What are Powder Brows? You see them everywhere! But what exactly are they? And what is the big difference between Powder Brows and other techniques?

body.heading: What are Powder Brows?
paragraphs: Powder Brows, also known as Ombré Powder Brows, are a semi-permanent makeup technique used to fill in the eyebrows and give them a soft, powdery look.

Unlike microblading, which mimics the hair-stroke technique, we use a more powdery technique for Powder Brows to create the illusion of fuller eyebrows. We do this by means of pixels. Pixels are tiny dots or specks that you leave in the skin, giving a powdery appearance. The result is a natural look that resembles the effect of eyebrow powder, hence the name Powder Brows.

body.heading: How are Powder Brows applied?
paragraphs: During a Powder Brows treatment we apply pigment to the skin using a special permanent makeup machine and a needle 1 mm long, which leaves tiny dots of pigment in the skin. The colour of the pigmentation is built up layer by layer to achieve the desired density and shape.
IZZI Beauty specialises in natural eyebrows, with the emphasis on building the eyebrow colour with pigment in a healthy, calm way, so that we can always add a little more at the touch-up if desired.

We also look specifically at what suits each person. For example, it is often not desirable to create a clearly defined, sharp shape for women who are a little older and have more mature skin. We believe it should suit the age.

body.heading: Benefits of Powder Brows
paragraphs: Long-lasting result: unlike traditional makeup that can fade during the day, Powder Brows last much longer. Depending on the skin type and care, the results can last up to three to four years.
Natural appearance: Powder Brows give the eyebrows a subtle, natural look, making it seem as if you naturally have full eyebrows, even without makeup.
Low maintenance: after the healing period of just 7 days, Powder Brows need minimal upkeep. You no longer need to spend time drawing or filling in your eyebrows every day.
Suitable for all skin types: Powder Brows can be adapted to different skin types and colours, making them suitable for almost everyone.

body.heading: Important considerations for Powder Brows
paragraphs: Aftercare: it is essential to follow your specialist's aftercare instructions carefully to ensure that your eyebrows heal well and the colour is retained as well as possible. The aftercare for permanent makeup has been drawn up by the GGD and the RIVM.

Colour fading: as with other semi-permanent makeup techniques, the colour of your Powder Brows will fade over time. To keep your eyebrows looking fresh, an occasional touch-up may be needed. We recommend scheduling the next annual touch-up within 1 year of the last treatment.

Professional specialist: make sure you choose an experienced and qualified professional to carry out your Powder Brows. You can also check whether the permanent makeup specialist is affiliated with the GGD and has been inspected. You can find the salon in the veilig tatoeëren en piercen database.

body.heading: How long do Powder Brows last?
paragraphs: In general, Powder Brows remain visible for between one and two years, depending on various factors including skin type, lifestyle and aftercare. Ultimately you can expect it to be around 3 to 4 years before the Powder Brows have disappeared completely.

The longevity of Powder Brows is influenced by the skin's natural cell renewal. When you are very young you have a lot of cell renewal; the older you get, the less strongly this is present in the body. External factors such as sun exposure, the use of certain skincare products such as retinol, and rubbing the eyebrows can also affect how long they last.

To keep the results for as long as possible, it is important to follow the correct aftercare. This includes avoiding exposure to direct sunlight, using SPF on the eyebrows, avoiding exfoliating products near the eyebrows, and regular touch-ups to keep the colour fresh.

body.heading: Benefits at a glance
paragraphs: Increased self-confidence, suitable for all skin types, does not create scar tissue in the skin, painless treatment, no redness after the treatment, no swelling after the treatment, 7 days of aftercare (super fast), can be applied over scars, a very natural powder effect, waking up with beautiful eyebrows, and symmetry in the eyebrows.
Thanks to these benefits, choosing Powder Brows can be a great option for anyone looking for long-lasting, natural and easy-to-maintain eyebrows.

het-helingsproces-van-pmu.title: The healing process of permanent makeup
het-helingsproces-van-pmu.excerpt: Permanent makeup offers a long-lasting solution for a well-groomed look, but the skin needs time to heal after treatment. This guide describes step by step what you can expect.
het-helingsproces-van-pmu.author: IZZI Beauty
het-helingsproces-van-pmu.seoTitle: The healing process of Permanent Makeup IZZI Beauty
het-helingsproces-van-pmu.seoDescription: The healing process of permanent makeup: what exactly can you expect? See the full timeline from start to finish here.

body.heading: What to expect
paragraphs: The skin undergoes wound healing after a PMU treatment. Correct maintenance is essential; without proper aftercare, recovery can be difficult or complications can arise. It is advisable to choose a salon with a GGD inspection.

body.heading: Immediately after the treatment
paragraphs: Redness, sensitivity and possible swelling are normal and disappear within hours to days. The colour initially looks much darker because the pigments sit in the top layer of the skin.
The body sheds around 40-60% of the colour in the first week, especially warm tones. This can result in a cooler, greyer appearance.
Limit irritation and avoid makeup on the treated area. Use the recommended aftercare ointment. Ice can reduce discomfort — apply it indirectly through a clean cloth to avoid direct skin contact.

body.heading: The first 24-48 hours
paragraphs: The small wound hardens and feels tight. Itching is normal, but do not scratch the scabs off — this removes pigment. A slight burning or tingling sensation is acceptable; severe pain requires a consultation with your GP. Redness decreases quickly.

Keep the area clean and hydrated according to the official RIVM/GGD guidelines; dry healing is forbidden. Avoid direct sunlight, heavy exertion and sweating for 7 days. Combine aftercare cream with SPF 50 sunscreen.

body.heading: Day 3-7: flaking phase
paragraphs: The treated area starts to flake, possibly with scabs. This is normal. With lip treatments, flaking starts earlier (day 2) and ends sooner (day 4). Colour differences can occur.
Important: do not touch the scabs — let them come off naturally. Use mild, unscented soap and apply aftercare ointment with a cotton bud.

body.heading: Week 2-4: recovery and stabilisation
paragraphs: Although visually healed after week 1, the deeper skin continues to heal for another 30-40 days — invisible but active. This is why specialists wait at least 5-6 weeks before treating again.

Scabs disappear and the pigment colour gradually becomes lighter and more natural. Lip pigmentation can look different under different light during this process. After 7 days, normal maintenance may resume, but extend the use of aftercare ointment if the skin is still sensitive.

body.heading: Month 2-3: final result
paragraphs: The definitive result now becomes visible, with a stabilised colour and shape. PMU is always offered in two sessions: the initial treatment plus a touch-up after 6-8 weeks. This touch-up corrects unevenness.

body.heading: How do you keep your permanent makeup looking its best?
paragraphs: Protect against UV radiation; this makes pigments fade faster. Hydrate the skin regularly. Schedule yearly or two-yearly touch-ups. Avoid peels on PMU areas. Place microneedling around (not on) PMU.

body.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: Healing proceeds in phases and takes several months before the final result is visible. Proper aftercare and patience ensure optimal results. Consult your PMU specialist if you have questions; IZZI Beauty also offers guidance via photos by WhatsApp or email.

jouw-perfecte-wenkbrauw-vorm-bepalen-in-.title: Determine your perfect eyebrow shape in 4 steps
jouw-perfecte-wenkbrauw-vorm-bepalen-in-.excerpt: The eyebrow shape that best suits your face — how do you determine this? What can you look at to work this out? We are happy to help you.
jouw-perfecte-wenkbrauw-vorm-bepalen-in-.author: IZZI Beauty
jouw-perfecte-wenkbrauw-vorm-bepalen-in-.seoTitle: Determine your perfect eyebrow shape - IZZI PMU
jouw-perfecte-wenkbrauw-vorm-bepalen-in-.seoDescription: The eyebrow shape that best suits your face. In 4 steps you get the perfect shape for your face! Anyone can do it at home.

body.heading: 1. What face shape do you have?
paragraphs: Is your face round, square, angular or heart-shaped? Determine this first, and then look at which eyebrow shape has been applied to that face. This way you already have an idea of what you can start from as the best fit for you.

body.heading: 2. Which eyebrow shape do you find beautiful yourself?
paragraphs: Choose a shape that you find beautiful. The most popular shapes are: straight, soft arch, medium arch and round.
Once you have determined the eyebrow shape you can move on to step 3.

body.heading: 3. How do you draw your eyebrows?
paragraphs: Do you use a pencil, paint, a gel or a kohl pencil for drawing? Always make sure you have a thin, sharp brush so you can achieve the right results. If you cannot draw sharp, clean lines, there is no point in trying. First get the right eyebrow products.

body.heading: 4. Determine the highest point of your eyebrow
paragraphs: Draw a straight line from the side of your nose, along the corner of your eye to your hairline. This is how you determine the end of the eyebrow. This is how far your line will need to go.
Draw a straight line from the start of both eyebrows on the highest side. Extend this through to the hairline on the right and on the left. This is how you determine the highest point of the eyebrow.
Draw a line from the lower side of the start of the eyebrow, parallel to the upper side. This is how you determine what the thickness of the eyebrow will be.
Draw the eyebrow and colour it in. Keep in mind that you do not want to colour in the starting sections of the eyebrow completely. This is how you get a beautiful fade.

permanente-make-up-onderschat.title: Permanent makeup underestimated
permanente-make-up-onderschat.excerpt: Permanent makeup remains underestimated because companies mainly share photos of freshly applied treatments. The final result after healing looks much more natural.
permanente-make-up-onderschat.author: IZZI Beauty
permanente-make-up-onderschat.seoTitle: Permanent Makeup Underestimated - IZZI Beauty Amsterdam
permanente-make-up-onderschat.seoDescription: Permanent makeup is still sometimes underestimated. Why would you want permanent makeup? What are the advantages and disadvantages? Read everything here!

body.heading: Permanent makeup underestimated
paragraphs: Permanent makeup is becoming better known in the Netherlands, but many people find it looks far too intense. This negative impression is largely created by misleading marketing photos.

body.heading: Healed permanent makeup
paragraphs: Companies mainly post images of freshly applied work, which looks very sharp, full of colour and highly defined. However, all types of permanent makeup pigment will decrease by 40-60% during the healing weeks.
Few companies show the final, healed result, which is much softer and more natural.

body.heading: What happens to permanent makeup when it has just been applied?
paragraphs: The pigment is strongly present. The PMU area can itch. The skin around the PMU can be red. The skin around the PMU can be swollen. The PMU area can feel tight.

body.heading: How long does permanent makeup need to heal?
paragraphs: On average the recovery period is 2 weeks, but full healing takes between 6-8 weeks. The skin forms scabs while the body naturally tries to shed the pigment.

Healing process day by day: 1 to 5 days scab formation; 6 to 11 days the scabs fall off; 12 to 15 days the permanent makeup lightens; 16 to 20 days the pigment colour comes back; 21 to 30 days the colour becomes fainter; 31 to 45 days the pigment stays roughly as it is now visible.

body.heading: What does healed permanent makeup look like?
paragraphs: After full healing the treatment appears softer. Powder Brows and Lip Blush become extremely soft. This soft, natural final result is even more beautiful than the initial photos, but because companies do not show this, a misleading picture of the treatment result is created.

vervagen-powder-brows-en-waarom.title: Fading Powder Brows, and why?
vervagen-powder-brows-en-waarom.excerpt: Permanent makeup is not truly permanent and fades after around 2-3 years. This article explains why this happens and how best to care for your PMU.
vervagen-powder-brows-en-waarom.author: IZZI Beauty
vervagen-powder-brows-en-waarom.seoTitle: Fading powder brows and why? IZZI Beauty Amsterdam
vervagen-powder-brows-en-waarom.seoDescription: Is permanent makeup really permanent? Do powder brows fade? After how long does this happen & why? We are here for all your questions!

body.heading: PMU fades
paragraphs: Perhaps you need a solution to make PMU fade more quickly. This may be the case if you want to get rid of it so that you can perhaps have a nicer, new PMU applied. And that way you do not have to undergo laser treatments.
PMU fades indirectly through the following things: through natural renewal of the skin, through the sun or sunbed, and through peels and scrubs.

PMU can discolour and after a number of years may give a greyish, red or dull undertone. This is because the skin absorbs the pigment and partly sheds it. In addition, through the sun and peels you can also experience that the skin is affected, and as a result the PMU will eventually fade as well.
It is standard advice to have a touch-up treatment within 2 to 3 years after the PMU is applied. This way you refresh the shape, colour and warmth again.

body.heading: Can you remove permanent makeup yourself?
paragraphs: The answer is no. You can influence it slightly by carrying out the activities above, such as a lot of sunbathing or having peels. But even then the permanent makeup will never disappear completely. It will take years before it has become much lighter at all, and weigh that against the amount of UV radiation, which is not good for your body.
Get advice from a clinic and look at several options for having your permanent makeup removed.

body.heading: Permanent makeup did not take
paragraphs: Anyone who has permanent makeup applied for the first time does not yet fully know what they are getting into. Permanent makeup treatments come with a lot of information, and it is important that you as a client follow the correct aftercare.
If you have permanent makeup applied, you are not finished after 1 treatment. And in addition, it may also be that the first treatment the permanent makeup pigment does not take on your skin at all.

When the permanent makeup has not taken the first time: do not despair, because often 8 days after the treatment the pigment fades away, and will later reappear. That is why you always have a recovery period of 6-8 weeks. Only after these 8 weeks can the result of the first time be fully viewed and assessed.

body.heading: How long does permanent makeup last on average?
paragraphs: On average, permanent makeup lasts between 2 and 3 years. The undertone and faint lines of the makeup will last longer. This is based on permanent makeup of the eyebrows. Because eyeliner can last up to 10 years; that is also because eyeliner is often done with black pigment.

Permanent makeup of the lips also lasts around 3 to 4 years. This colour tone will, however, stay warm and hold a little longer; this is because of all the underlying blood vessels that also play a part in retaining the colour.

body.heading: How can you best care for your permanent makeup?
paragraphs: Make sure you follow the aftercare properly. Aftercare is there to ensure as well as possible that the permanent makeup takes well after just 1 treatment. So it is partly in your own hands.
In the Netherlands, aftercare is in fact standardised by the GGD. The rules are simple: wash the eyebrows twice a day with unscented soap, and apply Bepanthen ointment to the eyebrows 3 times a day.
If it is Lip Blush, then it is mainly: keep dry for the first 4 to 6 days (so do not wash with soap) and apply the aftercare product you receive from the stylist every day.

In addition, you can yourself still watch out for certain things that are really not allowed for the first 2 weeks: no swimming, no sauna, no sunbed, no sunbathing, no peels, no harsh scrubs, no rubbing and no picking the scabs off.

body.heading: Can you permanently curl natural lashes yourself?
paragraphs: While lash lift kits exist for home use, professionals strongly advise against DIY application. The treatment demands specialised knowledge; improper use of chemical solutions risks serious eyelash damage. Chemical exposure to the eye itself poses additional hazards.
Though formal training courses exist for interested individuals, unsupervised home treatments remain inadvisable.

body.heading: Can eyelashes curl badly?
paragraphs: Natural eyelashes cycle through growth phases lasting 6-8 weeks. When stylists follow brand guidelines — particularly observing minimum 4-week intervals between treatments — damage remains minimal.
However, experienced technicians alert to individual variations perform treatments most safely. Excessive repetition, like any beauty procedure, risks harm.

body.heading: How permanent is permanent eyelash curling?
paragraphs: Despite the terminology, permanent curling isn't truly permanent. The effect lasts approximately 6-8 weeks until treated hairs naturally shed and regrow. Professional aftercare instructions, including optional keratin-rich lotions, optimize results during this timeframe.

body.heading: Cost of permanently curling your lashes
paragraphs: Treatments range from €45-€70 depending on salon and product brand — comparable pricing across providers.

body.heading: Aren't eyelash extensions cheaper?
paragraphs: Extensions and lash lifts serve different purposes. Extensions create volume and length; lash lifts enhance natural curl. Extensions require fills every 4-6 weeks, while lifts last 6-8 weeks, making pricing relatively equivalent overall.

body.heading: Curl and dye eyelashes permanently
paragraphs: Tinting occurs between treatment steps, with options including brown or black pigments. Black tinting produces maximum drama; blue-tinted black adds perceived depth and volume.

tips-to-improve-skills-for-eyelash-exten.title: Tips to improve skills for eyelash extensions
tips-to-improve-skills-for-eyelash-exten.excerpt: Lash skills create confidence when performing eyelash extension treatments. This guide shares eight practical tips to help both beginners and experienced professionals.
tips-to-improve-skills-for-eyelash-exten.author: IZZI Beauty
tips-to-improve-skills-for-eyelash-exten.seoTitle: Tips to improve skills for eyelash extensions - IZZI Beauty
tips-to-improve-skills-for-eyelash-exten.seoDescription: Your Lash Skills make you confident when performing an eyelash extension treatment. But how do you create them and improve your skills?

body.heading: Tip 1. Read, read and read
paragraphs: Dedicating half an hour daily to reading blogs about eyelashes, watching videos, and storing important information will help your skills improve quickly. Building knowledge through consistent learning is foundational to developing expertise.

body.heading: Tip 2. Purchase a practice head
paragraphs: Practice heads remain valuable tools beyond initial training courses. You can apply thin eyelash strips (0.10 or 0.12 C curl) to mannequin heads or silicone sticks to focus on specific improvements: splitting technique, glue application, hair placement straightness, and volume distribution.
Even experienced technicians benefit from occasional practice session refreshers.

body.heading: Tip 3. Try new products
paragraphs: The eyelash industry continuously innovates with hundreds of brands and thousands of products available. Expanding your knowledge prevents stagnation.
Many brands offer sample kits containing important products, and suppliers often provide product strips for testing or share valuable application tips via email or phone consultation.

body.heading: Tip 4. Use the right tweezer
paragraphs: Tweezers greatly determine how your set is placed. Selecting the correct tweezers significantly impacts placement success. If you're struggling with placement consistency, the issue may simply be your tweezers rather than technique.

body.heading: Tip 5. Keep tweezers clean
paragraphs: Bent or curved tweezers require replacement. Dirty tweezers — with cured glue residue — reduce effectiveness.

Three cleaning methods include: soaking in Barbicide, gently scraping with an old tweezers, or using a specialised cleaning jar with solvent-containing liquid (like acetone) to dissolve adhesive buildup.

body.heading: Tip 6. Use the right application products
paragraphs: Beyond primary products (glue, extensions, tweezers), supporting materials matter significantly. Different microbrush types and primers affect retention. If clients experience premature lash fallout, reconsider your microbrush and primer combination.
A moisturizing cream applied before patches prevents skin irritation and maintains supple skin during application.

body.heading: Tip 7. Glue
paragraphs: Balanced glue ratios on the base are critical — too much or too little both compromise results. Practice achieving proper proportions.

Apply glue to only 10-15% of the natural hair, not the entire strand, as thin natural hairs cannot support heavy adhesive amounts. This minimal application sufficiently adheres extensions while maintaining natural hair health.

body.heading: Tip 8. Focus on the position of the eyelash placement
paragraphs: Achieving proper placement involves several techniques: use small tape strips for inner corner placement, position outer lashes towards outer corners, tape baby hairs upward along placed hairs, maintain spacing between applications to prevent sticking, angle right-eye lashes slightly rightward and left-eye lashes leftward, and hold extensions longer during placement.
The matter the drier the base of the glue is — observing the glue colour change from shiny to matte indicates proper curing before releasing the extension.
